gen-1-28.promise: God blesses people and gives them a good place in his world—to grow, care for creation, and live under his kindness.
gen-1-28.context: Spoken at creation, after God made people in his image.

gen-1-29.promise: God promises to provide what people need. He gives plants and fruit from the earth as food.
gen-1-29.context: God’s kind provision in the world he made.

gen-3-15.promise: God promises that evil will not win forever. One day the woman’s child will crush the serpent’s head—even though it will cost him pain.
gen-3-15.context: God’s words to the serpent after the fall in Eden.

gen-8-21.promise: God promises he will never again curse the ground as he did, or destroy every living thing the way he did in the flood.
gen-8-21.context: After the flood, when Noah offered worship to God.

gen-8-22.promise: God promises that as long as the earth remains, seasons, day, and night will keep going. You can trust the steady rhythms he made.
gen-8-22.context: God’s quiet decision after the flood to keep the world stable for life.

gen-9-1.promise: After the flood, God again blesses people to be fruitful, multiply, and fill the earth.
gen-9-1.context: God’s first words to Noah’s family after they leave the ark.

gen-9-9-11.promise: God makes a lasting promise to Noah, his family, and every living creature: never again will a flood wipe out all life on the earth.
gen-9-9-11.context: God speaks to Noah and his sons after the flood.

gen-9-12-16.promise: God gives the rainbow as a sign of his promise. When he sees it, he remembers his word—never again will a flood destroy all life.
gen-9-12-16.context: God gives Noah a visible token of the flood lasting promise.

gen-12-2-3.promise: God promises to bless Abram, make him into a great people, and bring blessing to all families on earth through him.
gen-12-2-3.context: God calls Abram to leave home for a land God will show him.

gen-12-7.promise: God promises to give the land of Canaan to Abram’s children.
gen-12-7.context: At Shechem, after Abram entered Canaan.

gen-13-14-17.promise: God gives Abram all the land he can see, forever, and children as countless as the dust of the earth.
gen-13-14-17.context: After Abram and Lot parted ways over grazing land.

gen-15-1.promise: God tells Abram not to be afraid. He himself will be Abram’s shield and his very great reward.
gen-15-1.context: After Abram rescued Lot and refused the king of Sodom’s spoils.

gen-15-4-5.promise: Abram’s heir will be his own child, and his children will be as countless as the stars.
gen-15-4-5.context: Abram had feared a household servant would be his heir.

gen-15-13-14.promise: God tells ahead of time about oppression in a foreign land, then promises judgment on that nation and deliverance with great wealth.
gen-15-13-14.context: During the lasting promise ceremony when Abram asked how he would know he would inherit the land.

gen-15-18.promise: God promises to give Abram’s children the land from Egypt’s river to the Euphrates.
gen-15-18.context: Sealed by God alone passing between the lasting promise pieces.

gen-16-10.promise: God’s angel promises lonely Hagar that her children will become too many to count. She is not forgotten.
gen-16-10.context: Hagar fled from Sarai and met the angel of the Lord by a spring in the wilderness.

gen-17-4-8.promise: God gives a new name to Abram as Abraham, father of many nations, and pledges an everlasting lasting promise: to be their God and give Canaan as an everlasting possession.
gen-17-4-8.context: When Abraham was ninety-nine years old, God appeared as God Almighty.

gen-17-15-16.promise: God gives a new name to Sarai as Sarah and promises her a son; she will be a mother of nations and kings.
gen-17-15-16.context: Part of the same lasting promise appearance when Abraham was ninety-nine.

gen-17-19.promise: Sarah will bear Isaac, and God will establish an everlasting lasting promise with him and his children.
gen-17-19.context: Abraham had asked that Ishmael might live before God.

gen-17-20.promise: God has heard Abraham’s prayer for Ishmael. He will bless him, multiply him, and make him a great nation.
gen-17-20.context: God answers Abraham’s plea for Ishmael while confirming the lasting promise line through Isaac.

gen-18-10.promise: God promises Sarah will have a son—within a year, just as he said.
gen-18-10.context: Three visitors appear to Abraham by the oaks of Mamre; Sarah listens from the tent.

gen-18-14.promise: Nothing is too hard for the Lord; he will return at the appointed time and Sarah will have a son.
gen-18-14.context: God responds after Sarah laughed at the promise of a child in old age.

gen-21-12.promise: God reassures Abraham that the lasting promise line will be named through Isaac, while also caring for Ishmael.
gen-21-12.context: When Sarah asked Abraham to send Hagar and Ishmael away after Isaac’s weaning feast.

gen-21-17-18.promise: God hears the boy crying and tells Hagar not to be afraid. He promises to make Ishmael a great nation.
gen-21-17-18.context: Hagar and Ishmael were cast out and wandering in the wilderness of Beersheba.

gen-22-17-18.promise: Because Abraham did not withhold Isaac, God swears to multiply his children like stars and sand, give them victory, and bless all nations through his children.
gen-22-17-18.context: After Abraham’s obedience on Mount Moriah when God provided a ram.

gen-26-3-4.promise: God will be with Isaac, bless him, give him the lands, multiply his children like the stars, and bless all nations through his children.
gen-26-3-4.context: During a famine, God tells Isaac not to go down to Egypt but to stay in the land.

gen-26-24.promise: God tells Isaac not to be afraid. He is with him, will bless him, and will multiply his children for Abraham’s sake.
gen-26-24.context: At Beersheba, after conflict over wells with the Philistines.

gen-28-13-15.promise: God promises Jacob the land and countless children, blessing for all families through him, and his own presence—to watch over him, bring him home, and keep every word.
gen-28-13-15.context: Jacob’s dream of the stairway at Bethel while fleeing from Esau.

gen-31-3.promise: God tells Jacob to return home and promises, “I will be with you.”
gen-31-3.context: After years with Laban, when tension had grown over Jacob’s prosperity.

gen-35-10-12.promise: God gives a new name to Jacob as Israel, promises nations and kings from him, and confirms the land given to Abraham and Isaac.
gen-35-10-12.context: God appears again to Jacob at Bethel after he returned from Paddan Aram.

gen-46-3-4.promise: God tells Jacob not to be afraid to go to Egypt. He will make him a great nation there, go with him, and bring him home again.
gen-46-3-4.context: At Beersheba, as Jacob prepared to reunite with Joseph in Egypt during famine.

gen-48-21.promise: Jacob trusts God’s promise: God will be with Joseph and bring him back to the land of his fathers.
gen-48-21.context: Jacob blesses Joseph’s sons Ephraim and Manasseh near the end of his life.

gen-50-24.promise: Joseph trusts God’s promise: God will surely visit his people and bring them up to the land promised to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
gen-50-24.context: Joseph’s dying words in Egypt, looking forward to the exodus.

exo-3-7-8.promise: God promises that he has surely seen his people’s affliction, heard their cry, and know their sorrows; he has come down to deliver them and bring them to a good and large land.

exo-3-12.promise: God promises Moses, “I will certainly be with you.” His presence is the sign that God has sent him.

exo-3-14.promise: God tells Moses his name: “I AM WHO I AM.” He is the living God who sends help to his people.

exo-4-12.promise: God tells Moses to go, and promises to be with his mouth and teach him what to say.

exo-6-2-8.promise: God promises to free his people from slavery, take them as his own, and bring them into the land he swore to give them. He will be their God.
exo-6-2-8.context: Lasting promise name and seven I wills.

exo-12-13.promise: God promises that when he sees the blood, he will pass over that home. The plague of destruction will not touch them.

exo-14-13-14.promise: God tells his people not to be afraid. Stand still and see him save you—he will fight for you.

exo-15-2.promise: God is your strength and your song. He becomes your salvation—the God you can praise.

exo-15-13.promise: You, in your faithful love, have led the people that you have redeemed. You have guided them in your strength to your holy habitation.

exo-15-26.promise: God promises that when his people listen and walk in his ways, he watches over them as the Lord who heals.

exo-16-4.promise: God promises to rain bread from heaven each day—enough for the day—so his people can learn to trust him.

exo-16-12.promise: God promises that at evening you will eat meat, and in the morning you will be filled with bread; you will know that he is the Lord your God.

exo-19-4-6.promise: God reminds Israel he carried them on eagles’ wings to himself. If they listen and keep his promise, they will be his treasured people—a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.

exo-20-2.promise: God says he is the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

exo-20-5-6.promise: God is deeply serious about loyalty—and he shows faithful love to thousands of those who love him and keep his ways.

exo-20-12.promise: Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which the Lord your God gives you.

exo-23-20-22.promise: God promises to send an angel ahead to guard the way and bring his people to the place he prepared. When they listen, he stands against their enemies.

exo-23-25-26.promise: God promises to care for those who follow him—providing what they need and watching over their lives with his blessing.

exo-23-29-30.promise: God says he will not drive them out in one year; little by little I will drive them out before you, until you have increased and inherit the land.

exo-29-45-46.promise: God promises to live among his people and be their God. They will know he is the Lord who brought them out of Egypt.

exo-33-14.promise: God promises, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.” You are not left to walk alone.

exo-33-17.promise: God tells Moses he will do what he asked—because Moses has found favor, and God knows him by name.
exo-33-17.context: God knows his servant by name.

exo-33-19.promise: God promises to let all his goodness pass before Moses and to show mercy as he chooses. His goodness is real and free.
exo-33-19.context: God shows his goodness and mercy.

exo-34-6-7.promise: God shows who he is: merciful and gracious, slow to anger, full of faithful love and truth. He forgives sin—and he is also just.
exo-34-6-7.context: God tells Moses what he is like.

exo-34-10.promise: God makes a lasting promise: before his people he will do wonders never seen before on the earth.

lev-26-3-6.promise: God promises that when his people walk in his ways, he gives rain, harvest, and peace. They can lie down without fear.
lev-26-3-6.context: Blessings promised when people walk with God.

lev-26-9-12.promise: God promises to look on his people with favor, make them fruitful, and keep his lasting promise. He will live among them and be their God.
lev-26-9-12.context: God promises to be close to his people.

lev-26-13.promise: God reminds his people: he brought them out of Egypt so they would not be slaves. He broke their yoke and made them walk upright.
lev-26-13.context: God frees his people from slavery.

lev-26-40-42.promise: If people confess their sin and humble their hearts, God promises to remember his lasting promise with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—and remember the land.
lev-26-40-42.context: When people turn back, God remembers his promise.

lev-26-44-45.promise: Even in an enemy’s land, God will not reject his people to destroy them or break his lasting promise. He is still the Lord who remembers.
lev-26-44-45.context: Even in hard places, God will not abandon his promise.

num-6-24-26.promise: God promises his blessing over you: he will keep you, look on you with kindness, and give you peace.
num-6-24-26.context: The priestly blessing God gave for his people.

num-10-33-34.promise: The ark went before them to seek out a resting place; the cloud of the Lord was over them by day when they set forward.
num-10-33-34.context: God leads his people toward rest.

num-14-17-19.promise: Let the Lord’s power be great as you spoken: the Lord is slow to anger, abundant in faithful love, forgiving sin—pardon please according to your great faithful love.

num-14-20-21.promise: God says he has pardoned as Moses asked. And as surely as he lives, the whole earth will be filled with his glory.
num-14-20-21.context: God forgives in answer to prayer.

num-15-40-41.promise: God promises that remember and do my commandments and be holy to your God. he is the Lord your God who brought you out of Egypt to be your God.

num-21-8-9.promise: God provides a way to live: anyone bitten who looks at the bronze serpent on the pole will live.
num-21-8-9.context: God provides a way to live—later pointed to by Jesus.

num-23-19-20.promise: God is not like people who break their word. What he has said, he will do. You can trust his promise.
num-23-19-20.context: Even Balaam must say God keeps his word.

num-23-21.promise: He has not seen sin in Jacob; the Lord his God is with him. The shout of a king is among them.
num-23-21.context: God is with his people as their King.

num-24-5-7.promise: God paints a picture of blessing for Israel—good tents, flowing water, and a rising kingdom under his care.
num-24-5-7.context: A vision of blessing for God’s people.

num-24-17.promise: God promises a coming ruler: a star out of Jacob, a scepter rising out of Israel—not yet, but surely.
num-24-17.context: A promise of a coming ruler.

deu-1-29-31.promise: Do not be terrified. God goes before you and will fight for you—just as he did in Egypt and in the wilderness, carrying you like a father carries his child.
deu-1-29-31.context: Moses reminds the people how God fought for them.

deu-2-7.promise: These forty years the Lord your God has been with you; you have lacked nothing.
deu-2-7.context: Looking back on God’s care in the wilderness.

deu-4-7.promise: What great nation is there that has a god so near to them as the Lord our God is whenever we call on him?
deu-4-7.context: God is near when his people call.

deu-4-29-31.promise: If you seek God with all your heart and soul, you will find him. He is merciful—he will not fail you, destroy you, or forget his lasting promise.
deu-4-29-31.context: Hope for people far from home.

deu-4-39-40.promise: Know today that the Lord is God in heaven above and on earth beneath; there is no other. Keep his ways that it may go well with you and your children, and you may prolong days in the land.

deu-5-9-10.promise: Faithful love to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.
deu-5-9-10.context: In the Ten Commandments, God also speaks of mercy.

deu-5-29.promise: God longs for his people’s good—that they would have hearts to honor him, so it may go well with them and their children forever.
deu-5-29.context: God longs for his people’s good.

deu-6-4-5.promise: Hear, Israel: the Lord is our God; the Lord is one. Love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.
deu-6-4-5.context: Israel’s core call to love the one true God.

deu-7-6-8.promise: You are a holy people; the Lord has chosen you to be a people for his own possession—not because you were many, but because the Lord loves you and keeps the oath he swore to your fathers.
deu-7-6-8.context: God chose his people because he loves them.

deu-7-9.promise: Know that the Lord your God is God—the faithful God who keeps his lasting promise and faithful love for a thousand generations of those who love him.
deu-7-9.context: God is faithful to keep his promises.

deu-7-12-13.promise: If you listen to instructions, the Lord will keep lasting promise faithful love; he will love you, bless you, multiply you—bless fruit of body, ground, and cattle in the land he swore.
deu-7-12-13.context: Blessings that flow from walking with God.

deu-7-15.promise: the Lord will take away from you all sickness; he will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt on you.
deu-7-15.context: God’s care for his people’s well-being.

deu-8-2-4.promise: Remember how God led you in the wilderness. He fed you with manna; your clothes did not wear out, and your feet did not swell for forty years.
deu-8-2-4.context: A reminder of how God cared in hard places.

deu-8-7-10.promise: the Lord brings you into a good land—brooks, springs, wheat, barley, vines, figs, pomegranates, oil, honey—a land without scarcity; you will eat and be full and bless the Lord.
deu-8-7-10.context: God brings his people into a good land.

deu-8-15-16.promise: God led you through a hard wilderness—yet he brought water from the rock and fed you with manna, so that he might do you good in the end.
deu-8-15-16.context: God’s hard path was meant for their good in the end.

deu-9-3.promise: Know today that the Lord your God is he who goes over before you as a devouring fire; he will destroy them and bring them down before you.
deu-9-3.context: God goes ahead of his people.

deu-10-12-13.promise: What does the Lord require but to fear him, walk in his ways, love him, serve with all heart and soul, and keep commandments for your good?
deu-10-12-13.context: What God asks is for his people’s good.

deu-10-17-19.promise: the Lord your God is God of gods, who doesn’t regard persons nor take bribes; he executes justice for orphan and widow and loves the foreigner—love the foreigner therefore.
deu-10-17-19.context: God loves justice and cares for outsiders.

deu-11-11-12.promise: The land drinks water from the rain of heaven; a land the Lord cares for—the eyes of the Lord are always on it, from the beginning of the year to the end.
deu-11-11-12.context: God watches over the land with care.

deu-11-18-21.promise: Lay up these words in heart and soul. Bind them. Teach children—that your days and your children’s days may be multiplied in the land as the days of the heavens above the earth.
deu-11-18-21.context: Keeping God’s words close brings lasting life.

deu-11-26-28.promise: God promises that he sets before you today a blessing and a curse: blessing if you obey, curse if you don’t.
deu-11-26-28.context: God sets a clear choice before his people.

deu-12-9-10.promise: You have not yet come into the rest God has for you. When you cross the Jordan, he will give you rest from enemies and a safe home.

deu-15-4-6.promise: There should be no poor among you—for the Lord will surely bless you in the land—if only you listen; you will lend to many nations and not borrow.
deu-15-4-6.context: God’s blessing frees his people to be generous.

deu-18-15-18.promise: God promises that the Lord will raise up a prophet from among you like me; him you shall listen to. he will put my words in his mouth.
deu-18-15-18.context: God promises to raise up a prophet like Moses.

deu-20-1-4.promise: When you face a bigger army, do not be afraid. God is with you. He goes with you to fight for you and to save you.
deu-20-1-4.context: God is with his people even in battle.

deu-23-5.promise: Nevertheless the Lord your God wouldn’t listen to Balaam, but turned the curse into a blessing for you, because the Lord your God loved you.
deu-23-5.context: God turns a curse into a blessing because he loves.

deu-23-14.promise: the Lord your God walks in the middle of your camp to deliver you; therefore your camp shall be holy.
deu-23-14.context: God is present among his people to save them.

deu-26-17-19.promise: You have declared the Lord to be your God; the Lord has declared you to be a people for his own possession—to make you high above all nations for praise, name, and honor, a holy people.

deu-28-1-6.promise: If you listen diligently, the Lord will set you high above all nations; blessed in city and field, fruit of body and ground, basket and kneading trough, when you come in and go out.

deu-28-7-8.promise: the Lord will cause enemies to be struck before you; he will command the blessing on you in your barns and all you put your hand to in the land.

deu-28-11-12.promise: the Lord will grant abundant prosperity; he will open his good treasury the sky to give rain and bless all the work of your hand; you will lend to many nations.

deu-30-1-3.promise: When blessings and curses come and you call them to mind among the nations and return to the Lord, he will reverse your captivity and have compassion and gather you from all peoples.

deu-30-4-6.promise: If your outcasts are in the uttermost parts of the heavens, from there the Lord will gather you; he will bring you into the land; he will circumcise your heart and your children’s heart to love him—that you may live.

deu-30-8-10.promise: You will return and obey; the Lord will make you have abundance in all the work of your hand, fruit of body and cattle and ground—for the Lord will again rejoice over you for good if you turn.

deu-30-11-14.promise: God’s command is not too hard or far away. His word is very near you—in your mouth and in your heart—so you can do it.

deu-30-15-16.promise: God promises that he has set before you life and good, death and evil; love the Lord, walk in his ways, keep commandments—that you may live and multiply, and the Lord bless you in the land.

deu-30-19-20.promise: God promises that i call heaven and earth to witness: he has set before you life and death, blessing and curse; choose life that you may live—loving the Lord, obeying, clinging—for he is your life and length of days.

deu-31-6.promise: Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid—God goes with you. He will not fail you or leave you.

deu-31-8.promise: God himself goes before you. He will be with you. He will not fail you or leave you.

deu-32-9-10.promise: God's portion is his people; he found him in a desert land, encircled him, cared for him, kept him as the apple of his eye.

deu-32-11-12.promise: As an eagle stirs up her nest and flutters over her young, the Lord alone led him; there was no foreign god with him.

deu-32-36.promise: God will judge his people and have compassion on his servants when he sees their strength is gone.

deu-32-39.promise: God alone is God. He is the one who wounds and heals, who puts to death and makes alive. No one can deliver from his hand.

deu-33-12.promise: The beloved of the Lord will live in safety beside him. God covers him all day long and carries him close.

deu-33-26-27.promise: There is no one like God, who comes to help you. The eternal God is your home, and underneath you are his everlasting arms.

deu-33-29.promise: Happy are you, Israel. Who is like you, a people saved by the Lord, the shield of your help, the sword of your excellency!

jos-1-3-5.promise: God promises every place Joshua’s foot treads. No one will be able to stand against him. As God was with Moses, so he will be with Joshua—he will not fail or leave him.

jos-1-6-7.promise: Be strong and courageous. You will lead this people to inherit the land. Stay strong by carefully keeping God’s ways.

jos-1-8-9.promise: God tells Joshua to be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid—the Lord your God is with you wherever you go.

jos-3-7.promise: God promises that today he will begin to magnify you in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that as I was with Moses, so he will be with you.

jos-6-2.promise: God promises that see, he has given Jericho into your hand, with its king and mighty men of valor.

jos-10-8.promise: God promises that don’t fear them, for he has delivered them into your hands. Not a man of them will stand before you.

jos-14-9.promise: Moses swore: Surely the land your foot has trodden will be an inheritance to you and children forever, because you followed the Lord fully.

jos-21-43-45.promise: the Lord gave Israel all the land he swore; he gave rest all around; not a man stood; not one word failed of all God's good promises—all came to pass.

jos-23-10-11.promise: One man of you shall chase a thousand; for the Lord your God is he who fights for you as he spoke. Take diligent heed to love the Lord your God.

jos-23-14.promise: Not one thing has failed of all the good things the Lord your God spoke; all have come to pass, and not one thing has failed.

1sa-2-1-2.promise: My heart exults in the Lord; my strength is exalted; there is none holy like the Lord; neither is there any rock like our God.

1sa-2-6-8.promise: the Lord kills and makes alive; he brings down to Sheol and brings up; he raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy to sit with princes.

1sa-2-9-10.promise: He will keep the feet of his holy ones; the Lord will judge the ends of the earth; he will give strength to his king and exalt the horn of his chosen one.

1sa-7-12.promise: Samuel set up Ebenezer, saying, the Lord helped us until now.

1sa-12-22.promise: the Lord will not forsake his people for his great name’s sake, because it has pleased the Lord to make you a people for himself.

1sa-16-7.promise: the Lord doesn’t see as man sees; man looks at outward appearance, but the Lord looks at the heart.

2sa-7-8-11.promise: God promises that i took you from the sheepfold to be prince; he has been with you; he will appoint a place for his people Israel and plant them; he will give you rest from enemies; the Lord will make you a house.

2sa-7-12-13.promise: God promises that when your days are fulfilled, he will set up your seed after you; he will build a house for his name, and he will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.

2sa-7-14-16.promise: God says he will be his father, and he will be my son; my faithful love will not depart; your house and kingdom will be made sure forever; your throne established forever.

2sa-22-2-4.promise: God promises to be your safe place. When you call on him, he is like a strong rock and shield who protects and rescues you.

2sa-22-29-31.promise: You are my lamp, Lord; the Lord will light up my darkness. God’s way is perfect; his word is tested; he is a shield to all who take refuge.

2sa-22-33-34.promise: God is your strong fortress. He makes your way sure, gives you steady feet, and sets you on high places.

1ki-3-12-14.promise: God promises that he has given you a wise and understanding heart; he has also given you what you didn’t ask—riches and honor. If you walk in his ways, he will lengthen your days.

1ki-6-12-13.promise: God promises that if you walk in his ways, he will establish my word with you which I spoke to David; he will dwell among the children of Israel and will not forsake his people.

1ki-8-56.promise: Blessed be the Lord who has given rest to his people Israel according to all he promised; not one word has failed of all his good promise.

1ki-9-3.promise: God promises that he has heard your prayer; he has made this house holy; my eyes and my heart shall be there perpetually.

2ki-6-16.promise: God’s word to anxious hearts: don’t be afraid, for those who are with us are more than those who are with them.

2ki-19-30-31.promise: The remnant will take root downward and bear fruit upward; out of Jerusalem a remnant will go out; the zeal of the Lord will do this.

2ki-20-5.promise: God promises that he has heard your prayer; he has seen your tears. he will heal you; on the third day you will go up to God's house.

1ch-16-34.promise: Oh give thanks to the Lord, for he is good, for his faithful love endures forever.

1ch-17-11-14.promise: God says he will raise up your seed; I will establish his kingdom; he will build me a house; I will establish him in my house and kingdom forever; his throne forever.

1ch-28-20.promise: Be strong and courageous and do it; don’t be afraid nor dismayed, for the Lord God, my God, is with you; he will not fail you nor forsake you until all the work for God's house is finished.

1ch-29-11-12.promise: Yours, Lord, is the greatness, power, glory, victory, and majesty; both riches and honor come from you; you rule over all; in your hand is power and might.

2ch-7-14.promise: God promises that if his people who are called by his name humble themselves, pray, seek his face, and turn from wicked ways, then he will hear from heaven, forgive their sin, and heal their land.

2ch-7-15-16.promise: God promises that now my eyes will be open and my ears attentive to prayer in this place; he has chosen and made this house holy that his name may be there forever; my eyes and heart there perpetually.

2ch-15-2.promise: God promises to be your safe place. When you call on him, he is like a strong rock and shield who protects and rescues you.

2ch-15-7.promise: Be strong, and do not let your hands grow weak—for your work will be rewarded.

2ch-16-9.promise: The eyes of the Lord run back and forth throughout the whole earth to show himself strong on behalf of those whose heart is perfect toward him.

2ch-20-15-17.promise: God’s word to anxious hearts: don’t be afraid nor dismayed because of this great multitude; the battle is not yours, but God’s. Stand still and see God's salvation. the Lord is with you.

2ch-20-20.promise: Believe in the Lord your God, so you will be established; believe his prophets, so you will prosper.

ezr-8-22.promise: God’s hand is for good on all who seek him—but his power is against those who forsake him.

ezr-8-31.promise: God’s hand was on his people, and he delivered them from enemies and ambushes along the way.

neh-1-8-9.promise: God promises that remember the word: If you trespass he will scatter; but if you return and keep commandments, though scattered to the sky, he will gather from there and bring to the place I chose for his name.

neh-2-20.promise: The God of heaven will help us succeed. Therefore his servants will rise and build.

neh-8-10.promise: Don’t be grieved, for the joy of the Lord is your strength.

neh-9-17.promise: You are a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, abundant in faithful love, and didn’t forsake them.

neh-9-19-21.promise: In your manifold mercies you didn’t forsake them in the wilderness. The pillar didn’t depart. Forty years you sustained them—they lacked nothing.

job-1-21.promise: God promises that naked I came out of my mother’s womb, and naked he will return there. the Lord gave, and the Lord has taken away. Blessed be God's name.

job-5-17-18.promise: Happy is the one God corrects. Do not despise his training—he wounds, but he also binds up; his hands make whole.

job-8-20-21.promise: God promises he will not cast away a blameless man; he will yet fill your mouth with laughter and your lips with shouting.

job-11-13-15.promise: If you set your heart right and reach out to God, you will lift your face without shame. You will be steady and not afraid.

job-12-9-10.promise: Who doesn’t know that God's hand has done this, in whose hand is the life of every living thing and the breath of all mankind?

job-13-15.promise: God promises that he will kill me. he has no hope. Nevertheless, he will maintain his ways before him.

job-14-14-15.promise: God promises that if a man dies, will he live again? All the days of my warfare I wait until my release comes. You will call, and he will answer; you will long for the work of your hands.

job-16-19.promise: Even now, your witness is in heaven. The one who speaks for you is on high.

job-19-25-27.promise: God promises that i know that my Redeemer lives, and in the end he will stand on the earth; after my skin is destroyed, then in my flesh he will see God.

job-22-21-23.promise: Get to know God now and be at peace—good will come. Return to the Almighty, and you will be built up.

job-23-10.promise: God promises that but he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, he will come out like gold.

job-23-13-14.promise: But he stands alone. Who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does. For he performs that which is appointed for me.

job-33-27-28.promise: God promises that he sings before men: he has sinned; he has redeemed my soul from going into the pit; my life will see the light.

job-36-7.promise: He doesn’t withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne he sets them forever. They are exalted.

job-36-15-16.promise: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction and opens their ear in oppression. Yes, he would have allured you out of distress into a broad place where there is no constraint.

job-42-2.promise: God promises that i know that you can do all things, and that no purpose of yours can be restrained.

job-42-10.promise: the Lord restored Job’s prosperity when he prayed for his friends. the Lord gave Job twice as much as he had before.

job-42-12.promise: So the Lord blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning—sheep, camels, oxen, and donkeys in abundance.

psa-1-1-3.promise: God blesses the one who delights in his law with rooted stability and growth.
psa-1-1-3.context: Opening psalm contrasting the righteous and the wicked.

psa-2-7-8.promise: the Lord declares his Son and promises the nations as his inheritance.

psa-3-3-4.promise: God is a shield and the lifter of the head. He answers from his holy hill.

psa-3-5-6.promise: God holds you through the night. You wake because he sustains you—so you need not fear the crowds around you.

psa-4-3.promise: the Lord sets apart the godly for himself and hears when they call.

psa-4-8.promise: God alone can keep you safe. He gives peaceful sleep to those who trust him.

psa-5-11-12.promise: God spreads his protection over those who love him. He surrounds his people with favor like a shield.

psa-8-3-5.promise: The God of heaven crowns fragile people with glory and honor, and gives them a place of care over creation.

psa-9-9-10.promise: the Lord is a refuge for the oppressed and does not forsake those who seek him.

psa-9-18.promise: God will not forever forget the needy. The hope of the poor will not perish.

psa-10-17-18.promise: God promises that he hears the desire of the humble, strengthens their heart, and does justice for the orphan and oppressed.

psa-11-1.promise: In the Lord one takes refuge—even when the urge is to flee like a bird to the mountain.

psa-12-5.promise: the Lord arises to protect the poor and needy from those who malign them.

psa-14-5-6.promise: God is in the generation of the righteous. He is the refuge of the poor despite the wicked’s scorn.

psa-16-8-11.promise: With God at your right hand, you can stand firm. In his presence there is joy and the path of life.

psa-17-8.promise: God promises to keep his own as the apple of his eye and hides them under his wings.

psa-18-1-3.promise: God promises to be your safe place. When you call on him, he is like a strong rock and shield who protects and rescues you.
psa-18-1-3.context: David’s song after God rescued him from Saul.

psa-18-30.promise: God’s way is perfect, and his word proves true. He is a shield to everyone who takes refuge in him.
psa-18-30.context: A quiet thought about who God is.

psa-19-7-11.promise: God's law is perfect, restoring the soul; his teachings rejoice the heart and warn; in keeping them there is great reward.
psa-19-7-11.context: A song about how good God’s teaching is.

psa-20-6-7.promise: the Lord saves his chosen one and answers from heaven with saving strength—trust not chariots but God's name.
psa-20-6-7.context: A prayer asking God for help before a battle.

psa-22-24.promise: God has not despised the afflicted’s suffering, nor hidden his face; when they cried, he heard.

psa-22-26-27.promise: The humble eat and are satisfied; seekers praise the Lord; all families of nations will worship.

psa-23-1-4.promise: God is your shepherd—you lack nothing. He leads you to rest and peace, restores your soul, and walks with you even through the darkest valley.
psa-23-1-4.context: David’s psalm of trust in the Lord as shepherd.

psa-23-5-6.promise: God prepares a table, anoints with oil. He also pursues with goodness all one’s days into his house forever.

psa-24-3-5.promise: The clean of hands and pure of heart receive blessing from the Lord and righteousness from the God of salvation.

psa-25-8-10.promise: God instructs sinners in the way; his paths are faithful love and truth for lasting promise keepers.

psa-25-14.promise: The friendship of the Lord is with those who fear him; he shows them his lasting promise.

psa-27-1.promise: the Lord is light and salvation—reason not to fear; he is the stronghold of life.

psa-27-4-5.promise: God hides you when you seek him in his safe shelter and sets them on a rock in the day of trouble.

psa-27-10.promise: Even if father and mother forsake, the Lord will take up his own.

psa-27-13-14.promise: Belief in seeing God's goodness in the land of the living; wait for the Lord with strength.

psa-28-6-7.promise: God promises that he hears the cry for mercy; he is strength and shield, and the heart trusts and exults.

psa-28-8-9.promise: the Lord is strength to his people and saving refuge of his chosen one; he shepherds and carries them forever.

psa-29-11.promise: the Lord gives strength to his people and blesses them with peace.
psa-29-11.context: Voice of the Lord over the waters.

psa-30-5.promise: God’s anger lasts a moment, but his favor lasts a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.

psa-31-5.promise: You can place your life in God’s hands. He is the faithful God who redeems.

psa-31-19-20.promise: God stores up great goodness for those who honor him. He hides you in the shelter of his presence.

psa-31-23-24.promise: Love the Lord; he preserves the faithful. Be strong and take heart, all who hope in the Lord.

psa-32-1-2.promise: Blessed is the one whose wrong is forgiven and whose sin is covered; no deceit in the spirit.

psa-32-7-8.promise: God is hiding place and surrounding songs of deliverance. He promises to instruct and counsel with his eye.

psa-33-4-5.promise: God's word is right; his work is done in faithfulness; he loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of his faithful love.

psa-33-18-22.promise: God's eye is on those who fear him and hope in his faithful love—to deliver from death and keep alive in famine.

psa-34-4-7.promise: Those who seek the Lord are delivered from fears; the angel of the Lord encamps around those who fear him.

psa-34-8.promise: Taste and see that the Lord is good; blessed is the one who takes refuge in him.

psa-34-15-18.promise: God's eyes and ears are toward the righteous; he is near the brokenhearted and saves the crushed in spirit.

psa-34-19-22.promise: Many afflictions meet the righteous, but the Lord delivers; he redeems his servants; none who take refuge are condemned.

psa-35-9-10.promise: The soul will rejoice in the Lord and delight in his salvation—who is like God, delivering the poor from those too strong.

psa-36-5-9.promise: God’s faithful love reaches heaven; with him is the fountain of life, and in his light we see light.

psa-37-3-6.promise: Trust, do good, delight in the Lord—he gives the desires of the heart and brings forth righteousness like light.

psa-37-7-8.promise: Rest in the Lord and wait patiently; refuse fretting and anger that only leads to evil.

psa-37-23-24.promise: A person’s steps are established by the Lord; though they stumble, they will not be utterly cast down, for God upholds.

psa-37-25-26.promise: The righteous are not forsaken. Their children are not begging bread. They lend generously and their seed is blessed.

psa-37-39-40.promise: The salvation of the righteous is from the Lord; he is their stronghold in trouble and delivers them.

psa-39-7.promise: Lord, what am I waiting for? My hope is in you.

psa-40-1-3.promise: God promises that he hears the cry, lifts from the pit, sets feet on rock, and puts a new song in the mouth.

psa-40-11.promise: Do not withhold tender mercies; let faithful love and truth continually preserve.

psa-41-1-3.promise: God delivers, protects, and sustains the one who cares for the poor—even on a sickbed.

psa-42-5.promise: Even when your soul feels cast down, put your hope in God. Praise him for the help of his presence.

psa-42-8.promise: By day the Lord commands his faithful love; by night his song is with his people in prayer.

psa-43-3-5.promise: Send out light and truth to lead to God’s holy hill; hope in God—yet praise him, the help of your countenance.

psa-44-6-8.promise: Not bow or sword saves. God saves from adversaries; in God the people boast all day and give thanks forever.

psa-46-1-3.promise: God is your refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. Even if the earth shakes, you can find safety in him.

psa-46-10-11.promise: Be still and know that he is God; the Lord of Armies is with his people as their fortress.

psa-47-8-9.promise: God reigns over the nations; the shields of the earth belong to God. He is greatly exalted.

psa-48-14.promise: This God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to the end.

psa-49-15.promise: God promises he will redeem the soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me.

psa-50-15.promise: Call on God in the day of trouble. He will rescue you—and you can praise him for it.

psa-51-7-12.promise: God can cleanse, wash whiter than snow, restore joy of salvation. He also uphold with a willing spirit.

psa-52-8-9.promise: Like a green olive tree in God’s house, trust in his faithful love forever; praise and wait on his name.

psa-54-4.promise: God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.

psa-55-22.promise: Cast your burden on the Lord and he will sustain you; he will never allow the righteous to be moved.

psa-56-3-4.promise: When you are afraid, trust in God. Praise his word—people cannot ultimately harm what he holds.

psa-56-8.promise: God counts wanderings and puts tears in his bottle. They are in his book.

psa-57-1.promise: Take refuge in the shadow of God’s wings until the danger has passed.

psa-57-2-3.promise: Cry to God Most High who fulfills his purpose; he sends from heaven and saves, sending faithful love and truth.

psa-59-9-10.promise: God is the strength; the God of faithful love will meet me; God will let me look on foes in triumph.

psa-60-11-12.promise: Give victory, for human help alone is not enough; through God we will act with courage; he will defeat our enemies.

psa-61-1-4.promise: God leads to the rock higher than yourself and lets people in need dwell in his tent forever.
psa-61-1-4.context: Cry from the end of the earth.

psa-62-1-2.promise: Let your soul wait quietly for God alone. He is your saving help, your rock, and your fortress—you will not be deeply shaken.

psa-62-5-8.promise: Wait for God alone. Pour out your heart before him—he is a refuge for you.

psa-63-1-4.promise: God’s faithful love is better than life; lips praise him in the longing desert.

psa-64-10.promise: The righteous shall be glad in the Lord and take refuge in him; all the upright in heart shall glory.

psa-65-1-4.promise: God hears prayer, atones for wrongs, and satisfies with the goodness of his house.

psa-66-8-9.promise: Bless God—he holds your life in his hands and does not let your feet slip.

psa-66-16-20.promise: Come hear what God has done; he heard the voice of prayer and did not reject faithful love or prayer.

psa-67-1-2.promise: God be merciful. Bless us and cause his face to shine—so that his way may be known on earth, salvation among nations.

psa-68-5-6.promise: God is father of the fatherless and defender of widows. He sets the lonely in families and frees prisoners.

psa-68-19-20.promise: God bears his people’s burdens daily. He is the God of salvation to whom belong escapes from death.

psa-69-13.promise: As for me, my prayer is to you, Lord, in an acceptable time; God, in the abundance of your faithful love, answer me in the truth of your salvation.

psa-69-32-33.promise: The humble have seen it and are glad; seekers live—for the Lord hears the needy and does not despise his prisoners.

psa-70-4-5.promise: Let all who seek you rejoice; let lovers of your salvation say continually, Let God be exalted. Yet hasten to help the poor and needy.

psa-71-5-6.promise: God is hope and trust from youth. He has been the support from birth.

psa-71-14-16.promise: Hope continually and praise more and more. Tell of God’s righteousness and salvation all day.

psa-71-20-21.promise: God who showed many troubles will revive again, bring up from the depths, increase greatness. He also comfort.

psa-72-12-14.promise: The righteous king delivers people in need when they cry, redeems from oppression and violence—their blood is precious.

psa-72-17-19.promise: May the king’s name endure forever; all nations call him blessed; blessed be the Lord God who alone does wondrous things—fill the earth with his glory.

psa-73-23-26.promise: God holds the right hand, guides with counsel. He also afterward receives to glory; he is the strength of the heart forever.
psa-73-23-26.context: Asaph after envy of the wicked.

psa-73-28.promise: God promises that as for me, it is good to be near God; he has made the Lord GOD my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.

psa-77-11-14.promise: Remember God's deeds and wonders of old; your way is holy; what god is great like God?

psa-80-3.promise: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

psa-80-18-19.promise: Revive us, and we will call on your name; turn us again, Lord God of Armies; cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

psa-81-10.promise: God says he is the Lord your God who brought you out of Egypt; open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.

psa-84-5-7.promise: God promises a real blessing: blessed are those whose strength is in God—pilgrims who go from strength to strength appearing before God in Zion.

psa-84-11-12.promise: the Lord God is sun and shield; he gives grace and glory and withholds no good thing from the upright.
psa-84-11-12.context: Better one day in courts than a thousand elsewhere.

psa-85-1-3.promise: God showed favor to the land, brought back captivity, forgave sin, and covered all sin—withdrew all wrath.

psa-85-8-10.promise: God speaks peace to his people; faithful love and truth meet; righteousness and peace kiss.

psa-86-5.promise: God promises to be your safe place. When you call on him, he is like a strong rock and shield who protects and rescues you.

psa-86-15.promise: God promises to be your safe place. When you call on him, he is like a strong rock and shield who protects and rescues you.

psa-87-5-6.promise: Of Zion it will be said, This one and that one were born in her; the Most High himself will establish her; the Lord counts when he registers the peoples: This one was born there.

psa-89-1-4.promise: God’s faithful love and faithfulness endure; he made a lasting promise with David to establish his children forever.

psa-89-33-34.promise: God will not utterly take faithful love from David’s line nor allow his faithfulness to fail; he will not break his lasting promise.

psa-90-1-2.promise: Lord, you have been our home through all generations. From everlasting to everlasting, you are God.

psa-90-12.promise: Teach us to number our days, so we may gain a wise heart.

psa-90-14.promise: Satisfy us in the morning with your faithful love, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

psa-91-1-4.promise: Dwelling in God’s secret place means rest under Shaddai’s shadow. Refuge, fortress, wings, and faithfulness as shield.

psa-91-5-8.promise: No fear of night terror or day’s arrow; God deals with scourge and plague while those who trust him look on in safety.

psa-91-9-13.promise: Because the Lord is refuge, no evil will conquer; angels guard in all ways; the faithful tread lion and serpent.

psa-91-14-16.promise: God promises deliverance, exaltation, answered prayer, long life. He also shown salvation to the one who loves and knows his name.

psa-92-1-2.promise: It is good to give thanks to the Lord and to sing praises—to declare faithful love in the morning and faithfulness at night.

psa-92-12-15.promise: The righteous flourish like a palm and grow like a cedar—still fruitful in old age, declaring the Lord is upright.

psa-94-12-13.promise: Blessed is the one you discipline, Lord—taught from your law—to give rest from days of adversity until a pit is dug for the wicked.

psa-94-14-15.promise: the Lord will not reject his people nor forsake his inheritance; judgment will return to righteousness.

psa-94-18-19.promise: When the foot slips, God’s faithful love holds up; when anxieties multiply within, his comforts delight the soul.

psa-96-11-13.promise: Let heavens and earth rejoice. For he comes to judge the earth; he will judge the world with righteousness and the peoples with his truth.

psa-97-10-11.promise: God preserves the souls of his saints. Delivers from the wicked; light is sown for the righteous and gladness for the upright.

psa-98-1-3.promise: Sing a new song—he has done marvelous things; his right hand and holy arm have worked salvation; he has remembered faithful love and faithfulness to Israel; all ends of the earth have seen God’s salvation.

psa-99-8.promise: You answered them, Lord our God. You are a God who forgave them, although you took vengeance for their doings.

psa-100-5.promise: the Lord is good; his faithful love endures forever, and his faithfulness to all generations.

psa-102-17-20.promise: God regards the prayer of the destitute; he looks down to hear the groaning of the prisoner. Release those appointed to death.

psa-102-25-28.promise: God laid earth’s foundation; heavens wear out but God remains; the children of his servants will continue, and their children will be established before him.

psa-103-1-5.promise: God forgives sin, heals diseases, redeems from the pit, crowns with faithful love, and satisfies with good so youth is renewed.

psa-103-8-12.promise: the Lord is merciful and gracious; he has not dealt with us according to sins—as far as east from west, he removes wrongs.

psa-103-13-14.promise: As a father has compassion on children, the Lord has compassion on those who fear him—he knows our frame, that we are dust.

psa-103-17-18.promise: God's faithful love is from everlasting to everlasting on those who fear him, and his righteousness to children’s children.

psa-105-8-11.promise: God remembers his lasting promise forever—the word he commanded to a thousand generations—the lasting promise with Abraham, the oath to Isaac, confirmed to Jacob as a statute: to you he will give the land of Canaan.

psa-106-44-46.promise: Nevertheless he regarded their distress when he heard their cry; he remembered his lasting promise and relented according to his faithful love; he made them objects of compassion before captors.

psa-107-1-2.promise: Give thanks—his faithful love endures forever; let the redeemed say so, whom he redeemed from the hand of the adversary.

psa-107-13-16.promise: They cried to the Lord in trouble; he saved them, brought them out of darkness and broke their bonds.

psa-107-19-20.promise: They cry in their trouble. He saves them and sends his word to heal them and deliver from destruction.
psa-107-19-20.context: Sick from sin healed by God’s word.

psa-107-28-30.promise: Storm-tossed sailors cry out. God stills the storm to a whisper and brings them to their desired haven.

psa-108-12-13.promise: Give us help against the adversary, for human help alone is not enough; through God we will act with courage.

psa-110-1-4.promise: the Lord says to my Lord, Sit at my right hand; you are a priest forever after Melchizedek’s order.

psa-111-5.promise: God has given food to those who fear him; he always remembers his lasting promise.

psa-111-9-10.promise: He has sent redemption to his people; he has commanded his lasting promise forever—holy and awesome is his name. The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom.

psa-112-1-4.promise: Blessed is the one who fears the Lord; their descendants are mighty; light dawns in darkness for the upright—gracious and merciful.

psa-113-7-9.promise: God raises the poor from the dust. Lifts the needy from the ash heap to seat them with princes; he settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother.

psa-115-11-13.promise: Trust in the Lord—he is help and shield; he will bless those who fear him, small and great.

psa-116-1-9.promise: God hears the voice of supplication, deals bountifully, and delivers soul from death—walk before the Lord in the land of the living.

psa-116-15.promise: Precious in God's sight is the death of his saints.
psa-116-15.context: Costly care for his people’s lives.

psa-118-5-6.promise: God promises that out of distress I called; the Lord answered and set me in a large place. the Lord is on my side—he will not fear.

psa-118-8-9.promise: It is better to take refuge in the Lord than to trust in humans or princes.

psa-118-14-17.promise: God promises that the Lord is strength and song and has become salvation; he will not die but live and declare his works.

psa-118-22-24.promise: The stone the builders rejected becomes the cornerstone—this is God's doing; this is the day the Lord has made; rejoice.

psa-119-9-11.promise: A young person cleanses their way by taking heed according to God’s word. Hiding the word in the heart guards from sin.

psa-119-28.promise: My soul is weary with sorrow. Strengthen me according to your word.

psa-119-49.promise: Remember your word to your servant, Lord—because your promise gave me hope.

psa-119-50.promise: God’s promise gives life and is comfort in suffering.

psa-119-67-68.promise: Before affliction I went astray, but now I observe your word. You are good, and do good; teach me your ways.

psa-119-71-72.promise: God promises that it is good for me that he has been afflicted, that I may learn your ways; the law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of gold and silver.

psa-119-76.promise: Please let your faithful love be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.

psa-119-105.promise: God’s word is a lamp for your feet and a light for your path.

psa-119-114.promise: God is hiding place and shield. His people hope in his word.

psa-119-116.promise: Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.

psa-119-165.promise: Great peace have people who love God’s law; nothing causes them to stumble.

psa-120-1.promise: In my distress I cried to the Lord, and he answered me.

psa-121-1-4.promise: Help comes from the Lord, maker of heaven and earth—he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.

psa-121-5-8.promise: the Lord is keeper and shade; he preserves from all evil and keeps going out and coming in forever.

psa-124-6-8.promise: Blessed be the Lord who has not given us as prey; our help is in the name of the Lord, who made heaven and earth.
psa-124-6-8.context: If the Lord had not been on our side.

psa-125-1-2.promise: Those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion, which cannot be moved; as mountains surround Jerusalem, the Lord surrounds his people from this time forward and forever.

psa-126-5-6.promise: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy; anyone who goes forth weeping returns with sheaves of joy.

psa-127-1-2.promise: Unless the Lord builds the house, builders labor in vain; he gives sleep to his beloved.
psa-127-1-2.context: Pilgrim wisdom on work and family.

psa-127-3-5.promise: Children are a heritage from the Lord; the fruit of the womb is his reward—blessed is the man with a quiver full.

psa-128-1-4.promise: Blessed is everyone who fears the Lord; you will eat the labor of your hands; your wife like a fruitful vine, children like olive plants—thus is the man blessed who fears the Lord.

psa-130-1-2.promise: Out of the depths I cry to you, Lord; Lord, hear my voice; let your ears be attentive to my cry for mercy.

psa-130-3-5.promise: If God marked sins, none could stand—but with him there is forgiveness; wait for the Lord and in his word hope.

psa-130-7-8.promise: Hope in the Lord—with him is faithful love and abundant redemption; he will redeem Israel from all sin.

psa-131-1-3.promise: God promises that o Lord, my heart is not haughty; he has stilled and quieted my soul like a weaned child—hope in the Lord from this time forth and forever.

psa-132-11-12.promise: God promises that the Lord swore to David in truth: he will set on your throne the fruit of your body—if your children keep his lasting promise, their children also forever.

psa-132-13-16.promise: God promises that the Lord has chosen Zion; this is my resting place forever; he will abundantly bless her provision, satisfy her poor, clothe priests with salvation, and make saints shout for joy.

psa-133-1-3.promise: How good and pleasant when brothers dwell together in unity—like oil on Aaron, like Hermon’s dew on Zion, where the Lord commanded the blessing, even life forever.

psa-135-13-14.promise: Your name, Lord, endures forever; your renown throughout all generations. For the Lord will judge his people and have compassion on his servants.

psa-136-1-3.promise: Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good—his faithful love endures forever; give thanks to the God of gods and Lord of lords—his faithful love endures forever.

psa-138-1-3.promise: God says he will give thanks with my whole heart; by day I call and you answer and embolden me with strength in my soul.

psa-138-7-8.promise: Though walking in trouble, God revives; he stretches out his hand against wrath; he will perfect what concerns his servant—his faithful love endures forever.

psa-139-1-6.promise: God knows sitting and rising, thoughts from afar, paths and lying down. Such knowledge is too wonderful.

psa-139-7-12.promise: No escape from God’s Spirit. In heaven, Sheol, or the far sea, his hand leads and holds; darkness is as light to him.

psa-139-13-16.promise: God formed heart and knitted in the womb; all days were written in his book before one of them came to be.

psa-139-23-24.promise: Search me, O God, know my heart. Lead me in the everlasting way.

psa-140-12-13.promise: God promises that i know that the Lord will maintain the cause of the afflicted and justice for the needy; surely the righteous will give thanks; the upright will dwell in your presence.

psa-141-1-2.promise: Hurry to me, Lord; give ear when I cry; let prayer be like incense, the lifting of hands like evening sacrifice.

psa-142-1-5.promise: God promises that i cry with my voice to the Lord; I pour out my complaint; when his spirit is overwhelmed, you know my path. You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.

psa-143-8-10.promise: Cause me to hear your faithful love in the morning; cause me to know the way I should walk; deliver me; teach me to do your will; let your good Spirit lead me on level ground.

psa-144-1-2.promise: Blessed be the Lord my rock, who trains my hands for war; my faithful love, fortress, high tower, deliverer, shield, and the one in whom I take refuge.

psa-144-15.promise: Happy are the people who are in such a case; happy are the people whose God is the Lord.

psa-145-8-9.promise: God promises to be your safe place. When you call on him, he is like a strong rock and shield who protects and rescues you.

psa-145-13-16.promise: God’s dominion endures. He upholds all who fall, raises all who are bowed down, and satisfies the desire of every living thing.

psa-145-17-20.promise: God promises to be your safe place. When you call on him, he is like a strong rock and shield who protects and rescues you.

psa-146-5-9.promise: Happy is the one whose help is the God of Jacob. Keeper of truth forever, who executes justice for the oppressed, gives food to the hungry, frees prisoners, opens blind eyes, raises the bowed down, loves the righteous, preserves strangers, upholds orphan and widow.

psa-147-3.promise: God heals the brokenhearted and gently binds up their wounds.

psa-147-11.promise: the Lord takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his faithful love.
psa-147-11.context: Not strength of horse or legs.

psa-149-4.promise: For the Lord takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with salvation.
psa-149-4.context: Praise with dance and sword imagery.

pro-1-7.promise: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge, but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

pro-1-23.promise: God promises that turn at my reproof. he will pour out his spirit on you. he will make known my words to you.

pro-1-33.promise: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely. Will be at ease, without fear of harm.

pro-2-6-8.promise: the Lord gives wisdom; he stores sound knowledge; he is a shield to those who walk in integrity; he guards the paths of justice and preserves the way of his saints.

pro-3-1-2.promise: Don’t forget my teaching; keep commandments. For length of days, years of life, and peace they will add to you.

pro-3-5-6.promise: Trust in the Lord with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding. In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.

pro-3-7-8.promise: Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear the Lord and depart from evil—it will be health to your body and nourishment to your bones.

pro-3-9-10.promise: Honor the Lord with your substance and first fruits—your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats overflow with new wine.

pro-3-11-12.promise: Don’t despise God's discipline; don’t be weary of his reproof—for whom the Lord loves, he reproves, as a father the son in whom he delights.

pro-3-13-18.promise: Happy is the one who finds wisdom—more precious than silver. Long life in her right hand. In her left riches and honor.

pro-3-21-26.promise: Keep sound wisdom; it will be life to your soul; then you will walk in your way securely; the Lord will be your confidence and keep your foot from being taken.

pro-4-5-7.promise: Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget. Wisdom is the principal thing. Therefore get wisdom. Yes, with all your getting, get understanding.

pro-4-18.promise: The path of those who walk with God is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.

pro-4-20-22.promise: Attend to my words; keep them in your heart—for they are life to people who find them, and health to their whole body.

pro-6-20-23.promise: Keep father’s commandment and mother’s teaching. For the commandment is a lamp, teaching is light, and reproofs of instruction are the way of life.

pro-8-17.promise: God promises that i love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.

pro-8-32-35.promise: Listen to me; blessed are those who keep my ways. Blessed is the one who listens; for whoever finds me finds life and will obtain favor from the Lord.

pro-9-10-11.promise: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom; the knowledge of the Holy One is understanding. For by me your days will be multiplied and years of life added.

pro-10-3.promise: the Lord will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.

pro-10-12.promise: Hate stirs up conflict, but love covers wrongs.

pro-10-22.promise: God's blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.

pro-11-2.promise: Pride brings shame, but humility brings wisdom.

pro-11-24-25.promise: There is one who scatters and increases. The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters will also be watered himself.

pro-12-25.promise: Worry weighs a heart down, but a kind word brings gladness.

pro-13-12.promise: When hope is delayed, the heart grows sick—but a fulfilled longing is like a tree of life.

pro-14-26-27.promise: In the fear of the Lord is strong confidence; his children will have a place of refuge. The fear of the Lord is a fountain of life, turning from the snares of death.

pro-15-1.promise: A gentle answer turns away anger, but a harsh word stirs it up.

pro-15-13.promise: A glad heart shows on the face, but an aching heart can break the spirit.

pro-15-29.promise: the Lord is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.

pro-16-3.promise: Commit your deeds to the Lord, and your plans shall succeed.

pro-16-7.promise: When a man’s ways please the Lord, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.

pro-16-9.promise: A man’s heart plans his course, but the Lord directs his steps.

pro-18-10.promise: The name of the Lord is a strong tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.

pro-18-14.promise: A brave spirit can carry you through sickness—but a crushed spirit is hard to bear.

pro-18-24.promise: Many companions are not enough—but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.

pro-19-17.promise: God promises that anyone who has pity on the poor lends to the Lord; he will reward him.

pro-19-21.promise: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but God's counsel will prevail.

pro-19-23.promise: The fear of the Lord leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.

pro-20-22.promise: God promises that don’t say, he will pay back evil. Wait for the Lord, and he will save you.

pro-21-5.promise: The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit. Everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty.

pro-21-30-31.promise: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the Lord. The horse is prepared for battle, but victory belongs to the Lord.

pro-22-4.promise: The result of humility and the fear of the Lord is wealth, honor, and life.

pro-22-6.promise: Train up a child in the way he should go. When he is old he will not depart from it.

pro-24-13-14.promise: Eat honey. So is wisdom: when you find it, there will be a future; your hope will not be cut off.

pro-24-16.promise: Those who walk with God may fall seven times and still rise again—but trouble overthrows the wicked.

pro-28-13.promise: God promises that anyone who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.

pro-29-25.promise: The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in the Lord is kept safe.

pro-30-5.promise: Every word of God is flawless. He is a shield to people who take refuge in him.

ecc-3-11.promise: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man cannot find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.

ecc-3-14.promise: God promises that i know that whatever God does, it shall be forever. Nothing can be added to it, nor anything taken from it; and God has done it, that men should fear before him.

ecc-5-19-20.promise: Every man also to whom God has given riches and wealth, and has given him power to eat of it. This is the gift of God. He will not often remember the days of his life, because God occupies him with the joy of his heart.

ecc-12-13-14.promise: Fear God and keep his commandments. This is the whole duty of man. God will bring every work into judgment.

isa-1-18.promise: God invites: though sins are like scarlet, they shall be as white as snow. Reasoning together toward cleansing.
isa-1-18.context: Opening indictment turns to mercy offer.

isa-2-2-4.promise: In the latter days Zion is exalted. Nations stream to learn God’s ways. He judges and they beat swords into plowshares.

isa-4-5-6.promise: Over Mount Zion God creates cloud by day and flaming fire by night. A canopy and refuge from heat and storm.

isa-6-6-7.promise: A seraph touches the prophet’s lips with a coal from the altar: sin is taken away and sin forgiven.

isa-7-14.promise: The Lord himself gives a sign: the virgin will conceive and bear a son, Immanuel. God with us.

isa-9-2.promise: The people walking in darkness have seen a great light. On those in the land of the shadow of death, light has shined.

isa-9-6-7.promise: God promises a child is born for us—Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace—and his reign of peace will never end.

isa-10-20-21.promise: A remnant of Israel will return to the Mighty God and lean on the Lord in truth.

isa-11-1-5.promise: A shoot from Jesse’s stump. Spirit-resting Messiah judges with righteousness and equity for the poor and meek.

isa-11-6-9.promise: Wolf dwells with lamb; earth is full of the knowledge of the Lord as waters cover the sea—no harm on God’s holy mountain.

isa-12-1-2.promise: God’s anger turns away and he comforts; God is salvation—trust and not be afraid; the Lord is strength and song.

isa-12-3.promise: With joy you will draw water out of the wells of saving help.

isa-14-1-2.promise: the Lord will have compassion on Jacob and choose Israel again; strangers will join them.

isa-25-6-8.promise: On this mountain the Lord prepares a feast for all peoples and swallows up death forever; he wipes tears from all faces.

isa-26-3-4.promise: God keeps in perfect peace those whose mind is stayed on him because they trust; trust in the Lord forever—everlasting Rock.

isa-26-12.promise: Lord, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also done all our work for us.

isa-26-19.promise: Your dead shall live; their bodies shall rise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust. The earth will cast out the dead.

isa-28-16.promise: The Lord GOD lays in Zion a tried stone, precious cornerstone, sure foundation; anyone who believes will not be in haste.

isa-29-18-19.promise: In that day the deaf hear the words of the book. The blind see out of gloom. The humble and needy rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.

isa-30-15.promise: In returning and rest you will be saved. In quietness and trust will be your strength.

isa-30-18.promise: Therefore the Lord will wait to be gracious; he is a God of justice—blessed are all who wait for him.

isa-30-19-21.promise: A people in Zion will weep no more. He answers the cry. Teachers not hidden. Ears hear a word behind: This is the way, walk in it.

isa-32-1-2.promise: A king reigns in righteousness. Each will be like a hiding place from wind, a covert from tempest, streams in dry place, shadow of a great rock.

isa-32-17-18.promise: The work of righteousness will be peace. The effect quietness and confidence forever. My people will live in peaceful habitations.

isa-33-2.promise: Lord, be gracious to us; we have waited for you. Be our arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.

isa-33-5-6.promise: God promises to be your safe place. When you call on him, he is like a strong rock and shield who protects and rescues you.

isa-35-1-2.promise: The wilderness and dry land will be glad; the desert will rejoice and blossom like the crocus—they will see the glory of the Lord.

isa-35-3-4.promise: Strengthen weak hands and feeble knees; say to the fearful: Be strong, don’t be afraid. Your God will come with vengeance and save you.

isa-35-5-6.promise: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened, ears of the deaf unstopped; the lame leap like a deer, and the mute sing. For waters break out in the wilderness.

isa-35-8-10.promise: A highway of holiness—the redeemed walk there; the rescued of the Lord return to Zion with singing; everlasting joy on their heads; sorrow and sighing flee.

isa-38-16-17.promise: Lord, by these things people live. You restore me and make me live. You have loved my soul from the pit. You have cast all my sins behind your back.

isa-40-1-2.promise: Comfort, comfort my people—speak tenderly to Jerusalem; her warfare is accomplished; her sin pardoned.

isa-40-4-5.promise: Every valley exalted, mountain made low; the glory of the Lord shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together.

isa-40-8.promise: Grass withers and flowers fade, but the word of our God stands forever.

isa-40-10-11.promise: The Lord GOD comes as a mighty one. He gathers lambs in his arm, carries them in his bosom, and gently leads those with young.

isa-40-28-31.promise: The everlasting God does not faint; he gives power to the faint; those who wait for the Lord renew strength—mount up with wings like eagles, run and not be weary, walk and not faint.

isa-41-8-10.promise: God says, “Do not be afraid, for I am with you.” He will strengthen you, help you, and hold you up with his righteous hand.

isa-41-13-14.promise: God promises that i, the Lord your God, hold your right hand; don’t be afraid—he will help you. Fear not, worm Jacob; he will help you, says your Redeemer.

isa-41-17-18.promise: God promises that the poor and needy seeking water—I the Lord will answer; he will open rivers on bare heights and fountains in valleys.

isa-42-1-4.promise: God’s chosen Servant brings justice to the nations. A bruised reed he will not break. He will not fail until he sets justice in the earth.

isa-42-6-7.promise: God promises that i, the Lord, have called you in righteousness and will hold your hand; he will give you as a lasting promise for the people, a light for the nations—to open blind eyes and free prisoners.

isa-42-16.promise: God says he will bring the blind by a way they don’t know; I will make darkness light before them and crooked places straight. I will do these things and not forsake them.

isa-43-1-2.promise: God promises that fear not, for he has redeemed you; he has called you by name—you are mine. When you pass through waters, he will be with you; through rivers, they won’t overflow; through fire, you won’t be burned.

isa-43-4-5.promise: God promises that you are precious in my sight, and honored, and I love you; don’t be afraid, for he is with you—he will bring your children from the east.

isa-43-10-11.promise: God promises that you are my witnesses and his servant whom he has chosen—that you may know and believe me. I, even I, am the Lord; besides me there is no savior.

isa-43-18-19.promise: God says not to cling only to the past. He is doing something new—even making a way in the wilderness and rivers in the desert.

isa-43-25.promise: God promises that i, even I, am he who blots out your wrongs for my own sake; he will not remember your sins.

isa-44-2-3.promise: God promises that fear not, Jacob his servant; he will pour water on the thirsty and streams on the dry ground; he will pour his Spirit on your children.

isa-44-21-22.promise: God promises that remember these things, Jacob—he has formed you; you will not be forgotten. he has blotted out your wrongs like a thick cloud; return to me, for he has redeemed you.

isa-45-2-3.promise: God says he will go before you and make the rough places level; I will break doors of bronze and cut through bars of iron; I will give you treasures of darkness.

isa-45-5-6.promise: God says he is the Lord, and there is no other; I will gird you though you have not known me—that they may know from east to west there is none besides me.

isa-45-22.promise: God promises that look to me and be saved, all the ends of the earth; for he is God, and there is no other.

isa-46-3-4.promise: God promises that listen, house of Jacob—you carried from the womb: Even to old age he is he; even to gray hairs he will carry you. he has made, and he will bear; he will carry and will deliver.

isa-48-10-11.promise: God promises that he has refined you, but not as silver; he has chosen you in the furnace of affliction—for my own sake, for how should his name be profaned?

isa-48-17-18.promise: God says he is the Lord your God, who teaches you to profit and leads you in the way you should go. Oh that you had listened—your peace would be like a river.

isa-49-6.promise: God promises that it is too light a thing to raise up Jacob—he will also give you as a light to the nations, that my salvation may be to the end of the earth.

isa-49-8-10.promise: God answers in a time of favor and keeps his people. He guides them to springs of water. They will not hunger or thirst, and the heat will not strike them.

isa-49-13.promise: Sing, heavens; rejoice, earth—for the Lord has comforted his people and will have compassion on his afflicted.

isa-49-14-16.promise: God promises that zion said, the Lord has forsaken me—but can a mother forget her nursing child? Even these may forget, yet he will not forget you. he has engraved you on the palms of my hands.

isa-49-24-26.promise: God promises that shall the prey be taken from the mighty? Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away; he will contend with those who contend with you, and he will save your children.

isa-50-4-5.promise: The Lord GOD gives the tongue of disciples to sustain the weary with a word. Morning by morning he wakens the ear to hear.

isa-50-7-9.promise: The Lord GOD helps me; therefore he is not confounded; he sets his face like flint. He who justifies me is near—who will contend?

isa-51-3.promise: the Lord has comforted Zion; he has made her wilderness like Eden and her desert like the garden of the Lord—joy and gladness found in her.

isa-51-6.promise: Lift up your eyes to the heavens. The heavens will vanish like smoke, but my salvation will be forever, and my righteousness will not be abolished.

isa-51-11.promise: The rescued of the Lord will return and come with singing to Zion; everlasting joy will be on their heads; they will obtain gladness and joy; sorrow and sighing will flee away.

isa-51-12.promise: God himself promises to comfort you. You do not need to live in fear of people who are only passing away.
isa-51-12.context: God comforts people who fear other people.

isa-52-6-7.promise: My people will know my name; how beautiful on the mountains are the feet of anyone who brings good news, who publishes peace and salvation: Your God reigns!

isa-52-9-10.promise: Break forth into joy—the Lord has comforted his people and redeemed Jerusalem; all ends of the earth see the salvation of our God.
isa-52-9-10.context: Joy for those watching for God’s help.

isa-53-4-6.promise: He bore our griefs and carried our sorrows; he was wounded for our wrongs; the Lord has laid on him the sin of us all.

isa-53-10-11.promise: Yet it pleased the Lord to bruise him; he will see his children and prolong his days; my righteous Servant will justify many—he will bear their sins.

isa-54-4-5.promise: God’s word to anxious hearts: don’t be afraid, for you will not be ashamed; forget the shame of your youth—your Maker is your husband; the Lord of Armies is his name; the Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer.

isa-54-7-8.promise: God promises that for a small moment I forsook you, but with great mercies he will gather you; in overflowing wrath I hid his face, but with everlasting faithful love he will have mercy on you.

isa-54-10.promise: The mountains may depart, but my faithful love will not depart from you, nor will my lasting promise of peace be removed, says the Lord who has mercy on you.

isa-54-11-13.promise: God promises that o afflicted, storm-tossed, comfortless—he will lay your stones with colorful gems; all your children will be taught by the Lord, and great will be the peace of your children.
isa-54-11-13.context: Rebuilt with jewels; taught by God.

isa-54-14-17.promise: In righteousness you will be established; you will be far from oppression and terror. No weapon formed against you will prevail; this is the heritage of God's servants.

isa-55-1-2.promise: Come, everyone who thirsts, to the waters. Buy wine and milk without money. Why spend for what doesn’t satisfy? Eat what is good.

isa-55-3.promise: God promises that incline your ear and come to me; hear, and your soul will live: he will make an everlasting lasting promise with you, even the sure mercies of David.

isa-55-6-7.promise: Seek the Lord while he may be found; let the wicked forsake his way; return to the Lord and he will have mercy; to our God, for he will abundantly pardon.

isa-55-8-9.promise: My thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways. As the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways.
