isa-55-10-11.promise: As rain and snow water the earth, so God’s word that goes out from his mouth will not return empty. It will do what he sent it to do.

isa-55-12-13.promise: You will go out with joy and be led forth with peace; mountains break forth into singing. Instead of thorn, cypress; an everlasting sign.

isa-56-3-5.promise: God promises that let not the foreigner or eunuch say he is a dry tree—to the eunuchs who keep my Sabbaths he will give in my house a name better than sons and daughters, an everlasting name.

isa-56-6-7.promise: God promises that foreigners who join the Lord to serve him—he will bring to my holy mountain and make joyful in my house of prayer; my house shall be called a house of prayer for all peoples.

isa-57-15.promise: The High and Lofty One who inhabits eternity dwells with anyone who is of a contrite and humble spirit—to revive the spirit of the humble and the heart of the contrite.

isa-57-18-19.promise: God promises that he has seen his ways and will heal him; he will lead him also and restore comforts to him and to his mourners—creating the fruit of the lips: Peace, peace to him who is far off and to him who is near.

isa-58-6-8.promise: The fast God chooses: loose bonds of wickedness, free the oppressed, share bread with the hungry. Then your light breaks forth like dawn and your healing springs quickly.

isa-58-9-11.promise: Then you will call and the Lord will answer; if you pour yourself out for the hungry, the Lord will guide continually, satisfy in drought, and make you like a watered garden.

isa-59-1.promise: God's hand is not shortened that it cannot save, nor his ear heavy that it cannot hear.
isa-59-1.context: Problem is sin, not God’s power.

isa-59-20-21.promise: A Redeemer will come to Zion for those who turn from wrong; this is my lasting promise—my Spirit on you and my words in your mouth shall not depart from your children forever.

isa-60-1-3.promise: Arise, shine, for your light has come; the glory of the Lord rises upon you—nations come to your light and kings to the brightness of your rising.

isa-60-19-20.promise: The sun will no longer be your light by day—the Lord will be your everlasting light; your God will be your glory; your days of mourning will end.

isa-61-1-3.promise: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is on me to preach good news to the humble, bind up the brokenhearted, proclaim liberty to captives, comfort all who mourn. Give a garland for ashes, oil of joy for mourning.

isa-61-7-8.promise: Instead of shame, double portion; everlasting joy will be to them; I the Lord love justice and will make an everlasting lasting promise with them.

isa-61-10-11.promise: God says he will greatly rejoice in the Lord—he has clothed me with garments of salvation and a robe of righteousness; as the earth brings forth buds, the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring up before all nations.

isa-62-2-4.promise: Nations see your righteousness; you will be called by a new name; you will no longer be termed Forsaken or Desolate, but Hephzibah and Beulah—for the Lord delights in you.

isa-62-11-12.promise: Say to Zion, your salvation comes; they will call them The Holy People, The Redeemed of the Lord; you will be called Sought Out, A City Not Forsaken.

isa-63-7-9.promise: God says he will make mention of God's faithful love—in all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them; in his love he redeemed them and carried them all the days of old.

isa-64-4-5.promise: From of old men have not heard of a God besides you, who works for him who waits for him. You meet him who rejoices and works righteousness.

isa-65-17-19.promise: God promises to create new heavens and a new earth. Former troubles will not be remembered. He will rejoice in Jerusalem, and weeping will be heard no more.

isa-65-24.promise: God promises that before they call, he will answer; while they are yet speaking, he will hear.

isa-66-12-13.promise: God says he will extend peace like a river; as one whom his mother comforts, so I will comfort you; you will be comforted in Jerusalem.

isa-66-22.promise: God promises that as the new heavens and the new earth which he will make remain before me, so your children and your name will remain.

jer-1-5.promise: God promises that before I formed you in the womb I knew you; before you were born he sets you apart; I appointed you a prophet to the nations.

jer-1-7-8.promise: God promises that don’t say he is a child—you will go to whom he sends you. Don’t be afraid of their faces, for he is with you to deliver you.

jer-1-19.promise: God promises that they will fight against you, but they will not prevail; for he is with you to deliver you, says the Lord.

jer-3-12-14.promise: God promises that return, backsliding Israel—he will not look in anger, for he is merciful. Return, backsliding children, for he is a husband to you; he will take you one from a city and two from a family.

jer-3-15.promise: God says he will give you shepherds according to my heart, who will feed you with knowledge and understanding.

jer-6-16.promise: Stand in the ways and see. Ask for the old paths, where the good way is, and walk in it, and you will find rest for your souls.

jer-7-23.promise: God promises that obey my voice, and he will be your God, and you will be his people; walk in all the way that I command you, that it may be well with you.

jer-9-23-24.promise: God promises that don’t glory in wisdom, might, or riches—glory in this: that you understand and know me, that he is the Lord who exercises faithful love, justice, and righteousness in the earth.

jer-11-4.promise: God promises that obey my voice and do my commands—so you will be his people, and he will be your God.

jer-15-19-20.promise: God promises that if you return, he will restore you; he will make you a fortified bronze wall; they will fight but not prevail, for he is with you to save and deliver.

jer-16-14-15.promise: God promises that days are coming when it will no longer be said, As the Lord lives who brought up Israel from Egypt, but who brought them from the north country—he will bring them back to their land.

jer-17-7-8.promise: Blessed is the man who trusts in the Lord; he will be like a tree planted by water—leaf green in drought, not anxious in a year of drought, nor ceases from producing fruit.
jer-17-7-8.context: Trust vs cursed confidence in flesh.

jer-17-9-10.promise: The heart is deceitful above all things; I, the Lord, search the mind and try the heart, to give every man according to his ways.

jer-23-3-4.promise: God says he will gather the remnant of my flock and bring them back to their folds; they will be fruitful. I will set up shepherds over them who will feed them; they will fear no more nor be dismayed.

jer-23-5-6.promise: God promises that days are coming—he will raise to David a righteous Branch; he will reign as king and execute justice; Judah saved, Israel dwell safely; name: the Lord our righteousness.

jer-24-6-7.promise: God says he will set my eyes on them for good and bring them again to this land; I will build and not pull down. I will give them a heart to know me—they will be my people, and I will be their God.

jer-29-10-11.promise: God promises to keep his good word and bring his people home. He has plans for their welfare—plans for hope and a future, not for harm.

jer-29-12-14.promise: God promises that when you call and pray, he will listen. When you seek him with all your heart, you will find him—and he will bring you back from captivity.

jer-30-8-10.promise: God says he will break his yoke; don’t be afraid, Jacob, neither be dismayed—I will save you from afar; Jacob will return and be quiet and at ease, and no one will make him afraid.

jer-30-17.promise: God says he will restore health to you and heal you of your wounds, because they called you an outcast: It is Zion, whom no one cares for.

jer-30-18-22.promise: God says he will reverse the captivity of Jacob’s tents and have compassion on his dwellings; you will be my people, and I will be your God.

jer-31-3.promise: God promises that he has loved you with an everlasting love; therefore with faithful love he has drawn you.

jer-31-8-9.promise: God says he will bring them from the north country—the blind and lame, the woman with child; they will come with weeping, and with petitions I will lead them; I will cause them to walk by rivers of waters in a straight way.

jer-31-12-14.promise: God promises that they will come and sing in Zion height and flow to the goodness of the Lord; their soul will be as a watered garden; he will satiate the priests with fatness and his people will be satisfied with my goodness.

jer-31-16-17.promise: Refrain your voice from weeping—your work will be rewarded. They will come back from the land of the enemy. There is hope for your latter end. Your children will come back to their own border.

jer-31-20.promise: God promises that is Ephraim my dear son? Since I spoke against him, I earnestly remember him still; my heart yearns; he will surely have mercy on him.

jer-31-25.promise: God promises that for he has satiated the weary soul, and he has replenished every sorrowful soul.

jer-31-31-34.promise: God promises a new lasting promise: he will write his ways on people’s hearts, be their God, and forgive their sin—remembering it no more.
jer-31-31-34.context: God promises a new, heart-deep relationship.

jer-32-17.promise: Ah, Lord GOD! you have made the heavens and the earth by your great power—there is nothing too hard for you.
jer-32-17.context: Prayer in prison before buying field.

jer-32-27.promise: God promises that he is the Lord, the God of all flesh. Is there anything too hard for me?

jer-32-37-41.promise: God promises to gather his people, let them live in safety, give them one heart to fear him, and make an everlasting promise to do them good.

jer-33-3.promise: God promises that call to me, and he will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don’t know.

jer-33-6-9.promise: God says he will bring health and cure; I will reveal abundance of peace and truth; I will reverse captivity; it will be to me a name of joy, praise, and glory before all nations.

jer-33-10-11.promise: Yet again will be heard in this place the voice of joy and gladness, bridegroom and bride, and of those who say, Give thanks to the Lord of Armies, for the Lord is good; his faithful love endures forever.

jer-33-14-16.promise: God promises that days are coming—he will perform the good word; he will cause a Branch of righteousness to grow up to David; Judah will be saved; Jerusalem dwell safely; name: the Lord our righteousness.

jer-33-20-22.promise: God promises that if you can break his lasting promise of the day and night, then his lasting promise with David and the Levitical priests may also be broken—he will multiply David’s seed as the host of heaven.

jer-39-17-18.promise: God promises to rescue you in the day of trouble. You will not be handed over to those you fear. Because you trust him, your life will be spared as a prize.

jer-42-10-12.promise: God promises that if you stay in this land, he will build and not pull down; he will plant and not pluck up; don’t be afraid of the king of Babylon—he is with you to save you and deliver you; he will grant mercies.

jer-46-27-28.promise: God promises that don’t be afraid, Jacob his servant; he will save you from afar; Jacob return and be quiet. Don’t fear—he is with you; he will make a full end of the nations, but not of you; he will correct you in measure.

jer-50-4-5.promise: In those days Israel and Judah will come weeping and seek the Lord; they will ask the way to Zion, saying, Come and join yourselves to the Lord in an everlasting lasting promise that will not be forgotten.

jer-50-19-20.promise: God says he will bring Israel again to his pasture; in those days sin will be sought and not found, for I will pardon those whom I leave as a remnant.

lam-3-21-23.promise: This I recall to mind: God's loving kindnesses never cease; his compassions never fail; they are new every morning; great is your faithfulness.
lam-3-21-23.context: Hope in the middle of lament.

lam-3-24-26.promise: God promises that the Lord is my portion; therefore he will hope in him. the Lord is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him. It is good to hope and wait quietly for God's salvation.

lam-3-31-33.promise: The Lord will not cast off forever. Though he causes grief, he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses—he does not afflict from his heart.

lam-3-55-58.promise: God promises that i called on your name from the lowest dungeon; you heard my voice. You drew near when I called; you said, Don’t be afraid. Lord, you pleaded my soul’s cause; you redeemed my life.

ezk-11-19-20.promise: God says he will give them one heart and put a new spirit within; I will take the stony heart and give a heart of flesh, that they may walk in my ways and be my people, and I will be their God.

ezk-16-60-63.promise: God promises that nevertheless he will remember his lasting promise with you in the days of your youth and establish an everlasting lasting promise; he will establish his lasting promise that you may know he is the Lord; he will forgive all you have done.
ezk-16-60-63.context: Jerusalem’s unfaithfulness met by everlasting lasting promise.

ezk-18-21-23.promise: If the wicked turns from sins and keeps ways, he will live—have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked? says the Lord GOD, and not rather that he should return and live?

ezk-18-30-32.promise: God promises that return and turn from wrongs; cast away wrongs; make a new heart and spirit. For he has no pleasure in the death of him who dies; therefore turn and live.

ezk-20-41-44.promise: God says he will accept you as a sweet aroma when I bring you from the peoples; I will be sanctified in you; you will know I am the Lord when I deal with you for my name’s sake, not according to evil ways.

ezk-28-25-26.promise: When I gather Israel from peoples and am made holy in them, they will dwell in their land safely, build houses, plant vineyards, and dwell securely when I execute judgments on neighbors.

ezk-34-11-12.promise: God promises that i myself will search for my sheep and seek them out—as a shepherd seeks flock on cloudy day, so he will seek out my sheep and deliver them from all places scattered.

ezk-34-13-15.promise: God says he will bring them out from peoples and gather to their land; I will feed them on mountains of Israel; I myself will be the shepherd of my sheep and make them lie down.

ezk-34-16.promise: God says he will seek that which was lost, bring back that which was driven away, bind up that which was broken, and strengthen that which was sick.

ezk-34-22-24.promise: God says he will save my flock; they will no more be a prey; I will set up one shepherd over them, my servant David; I the Lord will be their God, and my servant David prince among them.

ezk-34-25-26.promise: God says he will make a lasting promise of peace; eliminate evil animals; they will dwell securely; I will make them and places around my hill a blessing; showers of blessing.

ezk-34-27-28.promise: God promises that the tree yields fruit, earth yield increase; they know he is the Lord when I break bars of yoke and deliver from hand of those who enslaved them; they will no more be a prey; none will make them afraid.

ezk-34-30-31.promise: God promises that they will know that I, the Lord their God, am with them, and that they are his people; you my sheep, the sheep of my pasture, are people, and he is your God.

ezk-36-9-11.promise: God is for you. He promises to turn toward you again, make the land fruitful, multiply people, and do good to you as in earlier days.

ezk-36-24-25.promise: God says he will take you from the nations, gather from all lands, bring to your own land; I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean; from idols I will cleanse you.

ezk-36-26-28.promise: God promises a new heart and a new spirit. He will remove the hard heart of stone, give a heart of flesh, put his Spirit in you, and be your God.

ezk-36-29-30.promise: God says he will save you from uncleanness; I will call for grain and multiply it and lay no famine; I will multiply fruit of tree and yield of field.

ezk-36-33-36.promise: God promises that in day I cleanse from sins he will cause cities to be inhabited; desolate land tilled; nations know I the Lord built ruined places—I the Lord have spoken and will do it.

ezk-37-5-6.promise: God says he will cause breath to enter you and you will live; I will lay sinews, bring flesh, cover with skin, put breath in you; you will live, and know I am the Lord.

ezk-37-12-14.promise: God promises to open the graves of his people, bring them home, and put his Spirit in them so they will live—and know that he is the Lord.

ezk-37-21-23.promise: God says he will take Israelites from nations, gather, bring to land; make one nation; one king; no more defile; I will save and cleanse; they will be my people, I their God.

ezk-37-24-27.promise: God promises that david his servant king forever; lasting promise of peace everlasting; he will set sanctuary in midst forever; my dwelling with them; I their God, they his people—nations know when sanctuary is forever.

ezk-39-25-29.promise: God says he will reverse captivity of Jacob and have mercy on whole house of Israel; I will not hide my face any more; I will pour out my Spirit on Israel, says the Lord GOD.

ezk-47-8-9.promise: Waters from the temple go toward east. When they enter the sea, waters are healed. Every living creature swarms wherever the river comes will live.

ezk-47-12.promise: By the river trees for food. Leaf won’t wither nor fruit fail. Fruit for food, leaf for healing.

dan-2-20-22.promise: Blessed be God’s name forever. He changes times and seasons. He removes kings and sets up kings.

dan-2-44.promise: In days of those kings the God of heaven will set up a kingdom which will never be destroyed. It will break other kingdoms and stand forever.

dan-3-17-18.promise: Our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace. But if not, we won’t serve your gods.

dan-3-24-25.promise: God promises that look, he sees four men loose, walking in the fire, and they have no hurt; the aspect of the fourth is like a son of the gods.

dan-4-34-35.promise: God promises that i blessed the Most High; his dominion is everlasting; all inhabitants of earth are reputed as nothing; he does according to his will; none can stop his hand or ask, What are you doing?

dan-6-22.promise: My God has sent his angel and has shut the lions’ mouths. They have not hurt me.

dan-6-26-27.promise: He is the living God, steadfast forever. His kingdom won’t be destroyed. He delivers and rescues, works signs in heaven and earth.

dan-7-13-14.promise: One like a son of man came with clouds; dominion, glory, kingdom given. All peoples serve him; dominion everlasting, won’t pass away; kingdom won’t be destroyed.

dan-7-18.promise: But the saints of the Most High will receive the kingdom. Possess the kingdom forever, even forever and ever.

dan-7-27.promise: The kingdom and dominion under whole heaven will be given to people of saints of Most High. Kingdom everlasting. All dominions serve and obey.

dan-9-9.promise: Mercy and forgiveness belong to the Lord our God—even though we have rebelled against him.

dan-9-18-19.promise: We don’t present pleas for our righteousness but for your great mercies. Lord, hear. Lord, forgive. Lord, listen and do. Don’t defer for your own sake.

dan-10-12.promise: God promises that don’t be afraid, Daniel; from the first day you set your heart to understand and humble yourself, your words were heard, and he has come for your words’ sake.

dan-10-18-19.promise: One like appearance of a person touched me and strengthened me: Peace be to you. Be strong, be strong. When he spoke, I was strengthened.

dan-12-1.promise: At that time Michael will stand up. There will be a time of trouble such as never was. But your people will be delivered, everyone found written in the book.

dan-12-2-3.promise: Many who sleep in the dust will awake, some to everlasting life. Those who are wise will shine as brightness of the expanse. Those who turn many to righteousness as the stars forever.

dan-12-13.promise: Go your way until the end. For you will rest, then rise again to receive your inheritance at the end of the days.

hos-1-10.promise: Yet the number of Israel will be as sand of sea. In place where said Not my people, it will be said Sons of the living God.

hos-2-14-15.promise: God says he will allure her and bring her into wilderness and speak comfortably; I will give vineyards from there and Valley of Achor for door of hope; she will respond as in youth.

hos-2-16-20.promise: God promises that you will call me My husband; he will betroth you to me forever in righteousness, justice, faithful love, mercies, and faithfulness; you will know the Lord.

hos-2-21-23.promise: God says he will sow her to me in earth; I will have mercy on No Mercy; I will say to Not my people, You are my people; they will say, My God.

hos-6-1-3.promise: Come, let’s return to the Lord. He has torn, but he will heal. He will bind us up, restore us, and come to us like the spring rains.

hos-11-1.promise: When Israel was a child, then I loved him. Called my son out of Egypt.

hos-11-3-4.promise: God promises that i taught Ephraim to walk; I took them on my arms; I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love; I lifted yoke and laid food before them.

hos-11-8-9.promise: God promises that how can he gives you up, Ephraim? My heart is turned within me; my compassions are kindled. he will not execute fierceness of anger—for he is God and not man, the Holy One among you.

hos-14-4-5.promise: God says he will heal their waywardness. I will love them freely; for my anger is turned away. I will be like the dew to Israel; he will blossom like the lily.

hos-14-7.promise: Men will rest in his shade. They will revive as grain and blossom as vine.

jol-2-12-13.promise: Turn to me with all your heart, with fasting, weeping, mourning; tear your heart and not garments; turn to the Lord—for he is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, abundant in faithful love, and relents from sending calamity.

jol-2-18-19.promise: God promises that then the Lord was jealous for his land and had pity on his people; he will send you grain, new wine, oil, and you will be satisfied; he will no more make you a reproach among nations.

jol-2-21-22.promise: God’s word to anxious hearts: don’t be afraid, land; rejoice—the Lord has done great things. Don’t be afraid, animals—pastures spring, tree bears fruit.

jol-2-23-24.promise: Rejoice in the Lord your God—he gives former rain moderately and rains; threshing floors full of wheat, vats overflow.

jol-2-25-27.promise: God says he will restore to you the years the swarming locust has eaten; you will eat plenty and be satisfied; my people will never be disappointed; you will know I am in midst of Israel.

jol-2-28-29.promise: God says he will pour out my Spirit on all flesh; sons and daughters prophesy; old dream; young see visions; on servants and handmaids I will pour out my Spirit.

jol-2-32.promise: It will happen that whoever will call on God's name will be saved; for in Mount Zion and Jerusalem there will be those who escape, as the Lord has said, and among the remnant those whom the Lord calls.
jol-2-32.context: Anyone who calls on the Lord can be saved.

jol-3-16-17.promise: God promises that the Lord will roar from Zion; the Lord will be a refuge to his people, a stronghold to Israel. So you will know he is the Lord your God, dwelling in Zion my holy mountain.

jol-3-18.promise: In that day mountains will drop sweet wine, hills flow with milk, all brooks of Judah flow with waters; a fountain will come from God's house.

amo-5-4.promise: God says, “Seek me, and you will live.”

amo-5-14-15.promise: Seek good and not evil, that you may live; hate evil, love good, establish justice—it may be that the Lord of Armies will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph.

amo-9-11-12.promise: God promises that in that day he will raise up David’s fallen tent and close up breaches; that they may possess remnant of Edom and nations called by his name.

amo-9-13-15.promise: God promises that days come—plowman overtakes reaper; mountains drop sweet wine; he will reverse captivity; they will rebuild cities and plant; he will plant them on their land and they will no more be pulled up.

oba-1-15-17.promise: The day of the Lord is near on all nations; as you have done it will be done to you. But in Mount Zion there will be those who escape, and it will be holy; Jacob possess possessions.

oba-1-21.promise: Saviors will go up on Mount Zion to judge Esau’s mountain; the kingdom will be God's.

jon-2-1-2.promise: Jonah prayed from the fish’s belly: I called because of my affliction to the Lord; he answered me. Out of the belly of Sheol I cried; you heard my voice.

jon-2-6-7.promise: God promises that i went down to the bottoms of mountains; the earth barred me forever—yet you have brought my life up from the pit. When my soul fainted, I remembered the Lord; my prayer came to you.

jon-2-8-9.promise: God promises that those who regard lying vanities forsake their own mercy. But he will sacrifice with voice of thanksgiving; salvation belongs to the Lord.

jon-3-9-10.promise: Who knows whether God will not turn and relent and turn from fierce anger that we not perish? God saw their works, that they turned. God relented of the disaster.

jon-4-2.promise: You are a gracious God, merciful, slow to anger, abundant in faithful love, and you relent of doing harm.

mic-4-1-3.promise: In latter days mountain of Lord’s house established; nations stream; he teaches ways; they beat swords into plowshares; nation not lift sword; nor learn war anymore.

mic-4-4.promise: But every man will sit under his vine and under his fig tree; no one will make them afraid, for the mouth of the Lord of Armies has spoken.

mic-4-5.promise: Though all peoples walk each in name of his god, we will walk in the name of the Lord our God forever and ever.

mic-5-2.promise: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah—though small among Judah’s clans—out of you will come a ruler for God, whose origins are from ancient days.

mic-5-4-5.promise: He will stand and shepherd in God's strength; they will live securely; he will be great to ends of earth. This one will be our peace.

mic-6-8.promise: God has shown you what is good: to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God.

mic-7-7-8.promise: God promises that but as for me, he will look to the Lord. he will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
mic-7-7-8.context: Fall and arise; light in darkness.

mic-7-9.promise: God says he will bear the indignation of the Lord because I have sinned; until he pleads my case and executes judgment for me. He will bring me into the light, and I will see his righteousness.

mic-7-18-19.promise: Who is a God like you, who pardons sin and passes over wrong of remnant? He doesn’t retain anger forever, because he delights in faithful love. He will again have compassion; he will tread our sins; cast all sins into depths of sea.

mic-7-20.promise: You will give truth to Jacob and faithful love to Abraham, as you have sworn to our fathers from days of old.

nam-1-7.promise: the Lord is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.

hab-2-3.promise: For the vision is yet for the appointed time. It hurries toward the end and won’t prove false. Though it takes time, wait for it, because it will surely come. It won’t delay.

hab-2-4.promise: his soul is puffed up. It is not upright in him, but the righteous will live by his faith.

hab-2-14.promise: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of God's glory, as the waters cover the sea.

hab-3-17-19.promise: God promises that though fig tree doesn’t flourish nor vines fruit, olive fail, fields food, flock cut off—yet he will rejoice in the Lord; he will be joyful in the God of my salvation. the Lord is my strength; he makes my feet like deer’s and enables me on high places.

zep-3-9-10.promise: God promises that then he will purify peoples’ lips that all may call on Lord’s name and serve shoulder to shoulder; from beyond rivers of Ethiopia my worshipers will bring offering.

zep-3-11-12.promise: God promises that you will not be put to shame for deeds; he will remove proud; he will leave among you a meek and humble people, and they will take refuge in God's name.

zep-3-13.promise: The remnant of Israel won’t do sin nor speak lies; for they will feed and lie down, and no one will make them afraid.

zep-3-14-15.promise: Sing, daughter Zion; the Lord has taken away judgments, cast out enemy; the King of Israel, the Lord, is in your midst; you will not be afraid of evil any more.

zep-3-16-17.promise: Do not be afraid. The Lord your God is in your midst—a mighty one who saves. He will rejoice over you with joy and quiet you with his love.
zep-3-16-17.context: God rejoices over you with singing.

zep-3-19-20.promise: God promises to deal with oppressors, save the lame, gather the outcast, and change shame into praise. He will bring you home and restore your fortunes.

hag-1-13.promise: God promises that then Haggai, God's messenger, spoke God's message: he is with you, says the Lord.

hag-2-4-5.promise: God promises that be strong, Zerubbabel; be strong, Joshua; be strong, all people of land—work, for he is with you. According to the word I covenanted when you came out of Egypt, so his Spirit remains among you. Don’t be afraid.

hag-2-6-9.promise: God says he will shake heavens and earth; I will fill this house with glory; the latter glory of this house will be greater than former; in this place I will give peace.

hag-2-19.promise: God promises that is the seed yet in the barn? From this day he will bless you.

hag-2-23.promise: God says he will take you, Zerubbabel my servant, and will make you as a signet, for I have chosen you.

zec-1-3.promise: God promises that return to me, says the Lord of Armies, and he will return to you.

zec-1-16-17.promise: God promises that he has returned to Jerusalem with mercies; my house will be built; cities will again overflow with prosperity; the Lord will again comfort Zion and choose Jerusalem.

zec-2-4-5.promise: God promises that jerusalem will be inhabited as villages without walls; he will be to her a wall of fire around, and he will be the glory in her midst.

zec-2-8-9.promise: God promises that he who touches you touches the apple of his eye; he will shake hand over them; you will know the Lord of Armies has sent me.

zec-2-10-11.promise: God promises that sing and rejoice, daughter Zion—for I come and he will dwell among you; many nations will join themselves to the Lord and be his people; he will dwell among you.

zec-3-4-5.promise: God promises that take the filthy garments off him; he has caused your sin to pass from you, and he will clothe you with rich clothing; set a clean turban on his head.

zec-3-8-9.promise: God says he will bring my servant, the Branch; I will remove the sin of that land in one day.

zec-4-6.promise: Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit, says the Lord of Armies.

zec-8-3-4.promise: God promises that he has returned to Zion and will dwell in Jerusalem; Jerusalem will be called City of Truth; old men and women sit in streets with staff.

zec-8-7-8.promise: God says he will save my people from east and west; I will bring them; they will dwell in Jerusalem; they will be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.

zec-8-12-13.promise: God promises that seed of peace; vine yield fruit; ground increase; heavens dew; remnant possess; as you were a curse among nations, so he will save you and you will be a blessing; don’t be afraid.

zec-8-16-17.promise: Speak truth; execute judgment of peace; don’t devise evil; love no false oath. For these I hate.

zec-9-9-10.promise: Rejoice greatly, daughter Zion—your king comes to you, righteous and having salvation, lowly riding on donkey. He will speak peace to nations. Dominion from sea to sea.
zec-9-9-10.context: King comes; peace to nations (Triumphal Entry).

zec-9-11-12.promise: God promises that because of blood of lasting promise he has set free your prisoners from the pit; return to stronghold, prisoners of hope; even today I declare he will restore double to you.

zec-10-1.promise: Ask of the Lord rain in spring; the Lord who makes storm clouds, and he gives rain showers to everyone for the plants in the field.

zec-10-6.promise: God says he will strengthen house of Judah and save house of Joseph; I will bring them back for I have mercy; they will be as though I hadn’t cast them off; for I am the Lord their God and I will hear them.

zec-12-1.promise: Thus says the Lord who stretches out heavens, lays foundation of earth, and forms spirit of man within him.

zec-12-10.promise: God says he will pour on David’s house and Jerusalem’s inhabitants the spirit of grace and of supplication; they will look to me whom they have pierced; they will mourn.

zec-13-1.promise: In that day a fountain will be opened for David’s house and Jerusalem’s people—for sin and for uncleanness.

zec-13-9.promise: God says he will bring the third part through fire, refine as silver, try as gold; they will call on my name and I will hear; I will say, It is my people; they will say, the Lord is my God.

zec-14-8-9.promise: Living waters will go out from Jerusalem; the Lord will be King over all the earth; in that day the Lord will be one, and his name one.

mal-1-2.promise: God promises that he has loved you, says the Lord. Yet you say, How have you loved us? Wasn’t Esau Jacob’s brother?

mal-3-1.promise: God promises that he sends my messenger and he will prepare the way before me; the Lord whom you seek will suddenly come to his temple.

mal-3-6.promise: For I, the Lord, don’t change; therefore you, sons of Jacob, are not consumed.

mal-3-7.promise: God promises that return to me, and he will return to you, says the Lord of Armies.

mal-3-10-11.promise: God promises that bring whole tithe into storehouse; prove me now—if he will not open windows of heaven and pour out a blessing that there won’t be room enough; he will rebuke devourer.

mal-3-16-17.promise: God promises that those who feared the Lord spoke; a book of remembrance was written; they will be mine, says the Lord of Armies, in the day when he makes up my jewels; he will spare them as a man spares his son.

mal-4-2.promise: But to you who fear my name, the sun of righteousness will arise with healing in its wings. You will go out and leap like calves of the stall.

mat-1-21-23.promise: You will call his name Jesus, for he will save you from their sins. They will call him Immanuel, which means God with us.

mat-4-4.promise: People do not live by bread alone, but by every word that comes from God’s mouth.

mat-5-3-10.promise: God promises a real blessing: blessed are the poor in spirit, mourners, meek, hungering for righteousness, merciful, pure, peacemakers, and persecuted—for theirs is the kingdom, comfort, inheritance, fullness, mercy, seeing God, and being called sons.

mat-5-11-12.promise: God promises blessing here: blessed when people revile and persecute you—rejoice and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven.

mat-6-6.promise: Pray to your Father in secret. Your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.

mat-6-8.promise: Your Father knows what you need before you ask him.

mat-6-9-13.promise: Pray: Our Father in heaven—hallowed name, kingdom come, will done, daily bread, forgive as we forgive, deliver from evil. For yours is kingdom, power, glory forever.

mat-6-14-15.promise: If you forgive others, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.

mat-6-25-26.promise: Jesus says not to worry about your life—what you will eat or wear. Look at the birds: they do not sow, yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not much more valuable than they?

mat-6-27-30.promise: Which of you by worrying can add a single hour to your life? If God clothes the grass so beautifully, will he not much more clothe you?

mat-6-31-34.promise: Jesus says not to worry about what you will eat or drink. Your Father knows you need these things. Seek first his kingdom and his righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well.

mat-7-7-8.promise: Ask, and it will be given to you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and the door will be opened. Everyone who asks receives.

mat-7-9-11.promise: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to children, how much more will your Father in heaven give good things to people who ask him?

mat-7-24-25.promise: God promises that everyone who hears these words and does them is like a wise man who built on rock; rain, floods, winds came—house didn’t fall.

mat-8-2-3.promise: Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean. Jesus touched him: I want to. Be made clean. Immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

mat-8-16-17.promise: He cast out spirits and healed all who were sick. That it might be fulfilled: He took our infirmities and bore our diseases.

mat-9-2.promise: Take heart, child—your sins are forgiven.

mat-9-12-13.promise: Those who are healthy don’t need a physician, but people who are sick. I desire mercy and not sacrifice, for I came to call sinners, not the righteous.

mat-9-21-22.promise: God promises that if I only touch his garment, he will be made well. Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well.

mat-9-36-38.promise: Jesus had compassion on the crowds—they were harassed and helpless, like sheep without a shepherd. Pray that the Lord of harvest send laborers.

mat-10-19-20.promise: Jesus says don’t be anxious how or what you will speak; it will be given in that hour—for it isn’t you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father who speaks in you.

mat-10-28-31.promise: Do not fear people who can only harm the body. You are precious to your Father—more than many sparrows. Even the hairs of your head are all counted.

mat-10-32.promise: God promises that everyone who confesses me before men, he will also confess before my Father in heaven.

mat-10-39.promise: God promises that anyone who finds his life will lose it, and he who loses his life for my sake will find it.

mat-10-42.promise: God promises that whoever gives one of these little ones a cup of cold water because he is a disciple will by no means lose his reward.

mat-11-28-30.promise: Jesus invites you to come to him when you are tired and weighed down. He promises rest for your soul. His way is gentle, and his burden is light.

mat-12-18-21.promise: God promises that his servant whom he has chosen; he will put his Spirit on him; he won’t break bruised reed; nations will hope in his name.

mat-12-31.promise: Every sin and speaking against God will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven.

mat-13-43.promise: Then those who walk with God will shine like the sun in their Father’s kingdom. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

mat-14-27.promise: But immediately Jesus spoke: Cheer up! It is I! Do not be afraid.

mat-16-18-19.promise: God promises that on this rock he will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it. he will give you keys of Kingdom of Heaven.

mat-16-24-25.promise: If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross. Follow me. Whoever loses his life for my sake will find it.

mat-17-5.promise: God promises that this is my beloved Son, in whom he is well pleased. Listen to him.

mat-18-3-4.promise: Unless you turn and become as little children, you will not enter Kingdom of Heaven. Whoever humbles himself as this little child is greatest.

mat-18-10.promise: See that you do not despise one of these little ones, for their angels always see my Father’s face.

mat-18-12-14.promise: If a man has 100 sheep and one goes astray, he seeks the one. It is not Father’s will that one of these little ones perish.

mat-18-19-20.promise: God promises that if two agree on earth concerning anything they ask, it will be done by my Father. For where two or three are gathered in his name, there he is in their midst.

mat-19-14.promise: Allow the little children, and don’t forbid them to come to me. For the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.

mat-19-26.promise: With people this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.

mat-19-28-29.promise: In regeneration when the Son of Man sits on throne, you who followed will also sit on twelve thrones. Everyone who left houses or family for my name will receive one hundred times and inherit eternal life.

mat-20-26-28.promise: God promises that whoever desires to become great among you shall be your servant; Son of Man came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.

mat-21-21-22.promise: If you have faith and don’t doubt, even to this mountain, Be taken up. It will be done. All things whatever you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive.

mat-24-13.promise: Anyone who endures to the end will be saved.

mat-24-30-31.promise: They will see Son of Man coming on clouds with power and great glory. He will send angels with trumpet to gather elect from four winds.

mat-24-35.promise: Heaven and earth will pass away, but Jesus’ words will never pass away.

mat-25-21.promise: God promises that well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things; he will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.

mat-25-34.promise: Come, you who are blessed by my Father. Inherit the kingdom prepared for you since the foundation of the world.

mat-25-40.promise: Whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.

mat-26-26-28.promise: This is my body; this is my blood of the new lasting promise, which is poured out for many for remission of sins.

mat-28-5-7.promise: God’s word to anxious hearts: don’t be afraid, for I know you seek Jesus who was crucified. He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Go tell his disciples he goes before you into Galilee; there you will see him.

mat-28-18-20.promise: Jesus has all authority in heaven and on earth. He sends his followers to make disciples—and promises, “I am with you always, to the end of the age.”

mrk-1-14-15.promise: The time is fulfilled. God’s Kingdom is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News.

mrk-2-17.promise: God promises that i came not to call the righteous, but sinners.

mrk-4-39-40.promise: He awoke and rebuked wind: Peace! Be still! Why are you so afraid?

mrk-5-34.promise: Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace. Be cured of your disease.

mrk-5-36.promise: God’s word to anxious hearts: don’t be afraid, only believe.

mrk-6-50.promise: Immediately he spoke: Cheer up! It is I! Do not be afraid.

mrk-8-34-35.promise: Deny yourself, take up your cross, and follow me. Whoever loses life for my sake and Good News’ will save it.

mrk-9-23.promise: If you can believe—all things are possible for the one who believes.

mrk-10-14-15.promise: Allow the little children to come to me. For God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these. Whoever doesn’t receive Kingdom as little child will not enter.

mrk-10-27.promise: With people it is impossible, but not with God—for all things are possible with God.

mrk-10-29-30.promise: Jesus promises that no one who has left home, family, or land for his sake and the Good News will fail to receive a hundred times as much now—and in the age to come, eternal life.

mrk-10-45.promise: Son of Man came not to be served but to serve. To give his life as a ransom for many.

mrk-11-24.promise: God promises that whoever says to mountain and doesn’t doubt but believes what he says happens—he will have whatever he says. Therefore all things you ask, believe you receive, and you will have them.

mrk-13-11.promise: Jesus says don’t be anxious beforehand what you will say; whatever given in that hour, say—for it is not you who speak, but the Holy Spirit.

mrk-13-13.promise: You may be hated because you belong to Jesus—but anyone who endures to the end will be saved.

mrk-13-26-27.promise: Then they will see Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory. He will send angels gather elect from four winds.

mrk-13-31.promise: Heaven and earth will pass away, but Jesus’ words will never pass away.

mrk-16-6-7.promise: Don’t be amazed. You seek Jesus the Nazarene who has been crucified. He has risen.

luk-1-30-33.promise: The angel tells Mary not to be afraid—she has found favor with God. She will bear a son, Jesus, who will reign forever on David’s throne.

luk-1-37.promise: Nothing God has spoken is impossible.

luk-1-45.promise: Blessed is the one who believed. What the Lord has spoken to her will be fulfilled.

luk-1-46-50.promise: My soul magnifies the Lord; he has looked at humble state; holy is his name. His mercy is for generations of people who fear him.

luk-1-52-55.promise: He has put down princes and exalted lowly; filled hungry with good things; he has given help to Israel remembering mercy. As he spoke to Abraham forever.

luk-1-68-75.promise: Blessed Lord God of Israel—he visited and redeemed; raised horn of salvation; mercy promised to fathers; remember holy lasting promise oath to Abraham—to grant we serve without fear in holiness.

luk-1-76-79.promise: You will go before Lord to prepare ways. Give knowledge of salvation by remission of sins—because of tender mercy, dawn from on high visit. Shine on darkness and death’s shadow.

luk-2-10-11.promise: Do not be afraid—this is good news of great joy for all people. A Savior has been born: Christ the Lord.

luk-2-14.promise: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace among those who receive his favor.

luk-2-29-32.promise: Now you release your servant in peace; my eyes have seen your salvation prepared before all peoples. Light for revelation to Gentiles, glory of Israel.

luk-4-18-19.promise: The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he anointed me to preach good news to poor. Sent to heal brokenhearted, proclaim release to captives, recovering sight to blind, deliverance to oppressed, proclaim acceptable year of Lord.

luk-5-12-13.promise: Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean. He stretched hand, touched: I want to. Be made clean. Leprosy departed.

luk-6-20-23.promise: God promises a real blessing: blessed are you poor—Kingdom is yours. Blessed who hunger—filled. Blessed who weep—laugh.

luk-6-35-36.promise: Love enemies, do good, lend expecting nothing. Your reward will be great. You will be children of Most High—for he is kind toward unthankful and evil. Be merciful, even as your Father is merciful.

luk-6-37-38.promise: Don’t judge and you won’t be judged; forgive and you will be forgiven. Give and it will be given. Good measure, pressed down, shaken together, running over.

luk-7-47-48.promise: Her many sins are forgiven—for she loved much. Jesus said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”

luk-8-48.promise: Daughter, take heart. Your faith has made you well. Go in peace.

luk-8-50.promise: God’s word to anxious hearts: don’t be afraid. Only believe, and she will be healed.

luk-9-23-24.promise: If anyone wants to follow Jesus, let them deny themselves, take up their cross daily, and follow him. Whoever loses their life for his sake will save it.

luk-10-19-20.promise: God promises that he gives you authority to tread serpents and scorpions and over enemy’s power; nothing will by any means hurt you. Nevertheless rejoice that your names are written in heaven.

luk-10-21.promise: God promises that i thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these from wise and understanding and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.

luk-10-22.promise: All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who Son is except Father. Who Father is except Son, and he to whomever Son desires to reveal him.

luk-11-9-10.promise: Ask and it will be given; seek and find; knock and opened. Everyone asking receives.

luk-11-11-13.promise: If you know how to give good gifts, how much more will heavenly Father give Holy Spirit to people who ask him?

luk-12-6-7.promise: Aren’t five sparrows sold for two coins, and not one forgotten by God? But the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Therefore don’t be afraid.

luk-12-8.promise: God promises that everyone who confesses me before men, the Son of Man will also confess before God’s angels.

luk-12-22-24.promise: Jesus says don’t be anxious for life—food; nor body—clothing. Consider ravens: they don’t sow, God feeds them. How much more value are you than birds!

luk-12-29-32.promise: Don’t seek what you will eat. Father knows you need these. Seek Kingdom and these will be added. Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.

luk-12-33-34.promise: Sell what you have and give to needy. Make purses that don’t grow old, treasure in heavens that doesn’t fail. For where treasure is, heart will be also.

luk-13-29-30.promise: They will come from east, west, north, south, and sit in God’s Kingdom. some last will be first, and some first last.

luk-15-4-7.promise: Shepherd leaves ninety-nine for lost sheep. When found, rejoices. Joy in heaven over one sinner who repenting, more than over ninety-nine righteous needing no repentance.

luk-15-8-10.promise: Woman seeks lost coin. Rejoices with friends. Joy before angels of God over one sinner repenting.

luk-15-20-24.promise: While still far off, father saw and was moved with compassion, ran, embraced, kissed. Bring best robe, ring, shoes. Kill fattened calf—this my son was dead and is alive again. Was lost and is found.

luk-18-7-8.promise: Will not God avenge his chosen who cry day and night, though he is patient? I tell you he will avenge them quickly. Nevertheless, when Son of Man comes, will he find faith on earth?

luk-18-13-14.promise: God, be merciful to me, a sinner! I tell you, this man went down justified rather than the other. For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but he who humbles himself will be exalted.

luk-18-16-17.promise: Allow little children to come. Kingdom of God belongs to such. Whoever doesn’t receive Kingdom as little child will in no way enter.

luk-18-27.promise: The things which are impossible with people are possible with God.

luk-18-29-30.promise: There is no one who has left house or wife or brothers or parents or children for God’s Kingdom’s sake who will not receive many times more in this time. In the world to come, eternal life.

luk-19-9-10.promise: Today saving help has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham. For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.

luk-21-14-15.promise: God promises that settle it in hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer, for he will give you a mouth and wisdom which all adversaries won’t be able to withstand or contradict.

luk-21-18-19.promise: Not a hair of your head will perish. By enduring, you will gain your lives.

luk-21-27-28.promise: They will see the Son of Man coming in cloud with power and great glory. When these things begin, look up and lift heads, because your redemption is near.

luk-21-33.promise: Heaven and earth will pass away, but Jesus’ words will never pass away.

luk-22-19-20.promise: This is my body given for you; this cup is new lasting promise in my blood, poured out for you.

luk-23-34.promise: Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing.

luk-23-42-43.promise: Jesus, remember me when you come into your kingdom. Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise.

luk-24-5-7.promise: Why do you seek the living among the dead? He isn’t here, but is risen. Remember how he spoke. Son of Man must be delivered, crucified, and third day rise again.

luk-24-38-39.promise: Why are you troubled? Why do doubts arise? See my hands and feet—it is I myself.

luk-24-46-49.promise: God promises that thus it is written that Christ suffer and rise third day; repentance and remission of sins proclaimed in his name to all nations. he sends promise of Father on you; stay until clothed with power from on high.

jhn-1-12-13.promise: As many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to people who believe in his name—born not of blood nor will of flesh nor man, but of God.

jhn-1-14.promise: The Word became flesh and lived among us. We have seen his glory—glory as of the only Son from the Father, full of grace and truth.

jhn-1-16-17.promise: From Jesus’ fullness we have all received grace upon grace. The law came through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.

jhn-1-29.promise: the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

jhn-3-3-5.promise: Unless one is born anew, he cannot see God’s Kingdom. Unless born of water and Spirit, he cannot enter God’s Kingdom.

jhn-3-14-15.promise: As Moses lifted up serpent in wilderness, so must the Son of Man be lifted up, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

jhn-3-16-17.promise: God loved the world so much that he gave his one and only Son, so that everyone who believes in him will not be lost but have eternal life.

jhn-3-18.promise: God promises that anyone who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the only born Son of God.

jhn-3-36.promise: One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son will not see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.

jhn-4-13-14.promise: God promises that everyone who drinks this water will thirst again, but whoever drinks of the water that he will give will never thirst; the water he gives will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.

jhn-4-23-24.promise: True worshipers will worship Father in spirit and truth, for Father seeks such. God is spirit, and people who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.

jhn-5-24.promise: God promises that anyone who hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life, and doesn’t come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.

jhn-5-28-29.promise: Hour comes when all in tombs will hear his voice and come out—people who have done good to resurrection of life.

jhn-6-35.promise: God says he is the bread of life. He who comes to me will not be hungry, and he who believes in me will never be thirsty.

jhn-6-37.promise: God promises that all those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me he will in no way throw out.

jhn-6-39-40.promise: God promises that this is will of Father: of all he has given me I should lose nothing but raise it up at last day. Everyone who sees Son and believes has eternal life; he will raise him up at last day.

jhn-6-47-48.promise: God promises that most certainly, he who believes in me has eternal life. he is the bread of life.

jhn-6-51.promise: God says he is the living bread from heaven; if anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. The bread I will give is my flesh for life of world.

jhn-6-54-56.promise: God promises that he who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and he will raise him up at last day. He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.

jhn-6-63.promise: It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit. Are life.

jhn-7-37-38.promise: Jesus says, if anyone is thirsty, come to him and drink. Whoever believes in him will have rivers of living water flowing from within.

jhn-8-12.promise: God says he is the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.

jhn-8-31-32.promise: If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples. You will know the truth. The truth will make you free.

jhn-8-34-36.promise: God promises that everyone who commits sin is bondservant of sin. If the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.

jhn-8-51.promise: Jesus promises that anyone who keeps his word will never see death.

jhn-9-4-5.promise: God promises that i must work works of him who sent me while it is day. When night comes, no one can work. While he is in the world, he is the light of the world.

jhn-10-9-10.promise: God says he is the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out and will find pasture. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.

jhn-10-11.promise: God says he is the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

jhn-10-14-15.promise: God says he is the good shepherd. I know my own, and I’m known by my own; even as Father knows me and I know Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.

jhn-10-27-29.promise: God promises that my sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me. he gives eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.

jhn-10-30.promise: God promises that i and the Father are one.

jhn-11-25-26.promise: God says he is the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies. Whoever lives and believes in me will never die.

jhn-11-40.promise: Jesus asks, “Did I not tell you that if you believed, you would see God’s glory?”

jhn-12-24-25.promise: Unless a grain of wheat falls into earth and dies, it remains alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit. He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.

jhn-12-32.promise: God promises that and I, if he is lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.

jhn-12-46.promise: God promises that he has come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.
jhn-12-46.context: Light so not remain in dark.

jhn-13-34-35.promise: God promises that a new commandment: love one another. Just as he has loved you, you also love one another. By this everyone will know you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.

jhn-14-1-3.promise: God promises that don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.

jhn-14-6.promise: God says he is the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.

jhn-14-12-14.promise: God promises that he who believes in me, works I do he will do also; greater works—because I go to Father. Whatever you will ask in his name, he will do, that Father may be glorified in Son. If you will ask anything in his name, he will do it.

jhn-14-15-17.promise: God promises that if you love me, keep my commandments. he will pray Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever: the Spirit of truth. You know him, for he lives with you and will be in you.

jhn-14-18.promise: God says he will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.

jhn-14-19-20.promise: God promises that because I live, you will live also. In that day you will know that he is in my Father, you in me, and I in you.

jhn-14-21.promise: God promises that one who has my commandments and keeps them is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my Father, and he will love him, and will reveal myself to him.

jhn-14-23.promise: If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him. We will come to him and make our home with him.

jhn-14-26.promise: The Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom Father will send in my name, will teach you all things. Will remind you of all that I said to you.

jhn-14-27.promise: Jesus gives you his peace—not like the world’s peace. Do not let your heart be troubled or afraid.

jhn-15-1-2.promise: God says he is the true vine, and my Father is the farmer. Every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.

jhn-15-4-5.promise: God promises that remain in me, and I in you. As branch can’t bear fruit by itself unless it remains in vine, so neither can you unless you remain in me. he is the vine.

jhn-15-7-8.promise: If you remain in me. My words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you. In this my Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit.

jhn-15-9-11.promise: God promises that even as Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love. If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love.

jhn-15-12-13.promise: God promises that this is my commandment, that you love one another, even as he has loved you. Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.

jhn-15-15-16.promise: God promises that no longer do I call you servants… but he has called you friends. You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain—that whatever you will ask of Father in his name, he may give it to you.
jhn-15-15-16.context: Friends; chosen to bear lasting fruit.

jhn-15-26.promise: God promises that when the Counselor has come, whom he will send to you from Father, the Spirit of truth who proceeds from Father, he will testify about me.

jhn-16-7.promise: God promises that it is to your advantage that I go away; for if I don’t go, Counselor won’t come; but if I go, he will send him to you.

jhn-16-13-14.promise: When he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth. He will not speak from himself, but whatever he hears he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming. He will glorify me.

jhn-16-20-22.promise: God promises that you will weep and lament, but world will rejoice; you will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy. You have sorrow now, but he will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away.

jhn-16-23-24.promise: Most certainly, whatever you may ask of Father in my name, he will give it to you. Until now you asked nothing in my name. Ask. You will receive, that your joy may be made full.

jhn-16-27.promise: The Father himself loves you, because you have loved me. Have believed that I came from God.

jhn-16-33.promise: God promises that he has told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! he has overcome the world.
jhn-16-33.context: Overcome the world; peace in me.

jhn-17-3.promise: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God. Him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.

jhn-17-11.promise: Jesus prays, “Holy Father, keep them in your name that you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are one.”

jhn-17-15-17.promise: God promises that i pray not that you would take them from world, but that you would keep them from evil one. Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth.
jhn-17-15-17.context: Kept from evil; sanctified in truth.

jhn-17-20-23.promise: God promises that i pray for those also who believe through their word—that they may all be one… I in them, you in me, that they may be perfected into one; that world may know you sent me and loved them even as you loved me.

jhn-17-24.promise: God promises that father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where he is, that they may see his glory which you have given me, for you loved me before foundation of world.

jhn-17-26.promise: God promises that i made known to them your name, and will make it known; that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them.
jhn-17-26.context: Love in them; I in them.

jhn-20-19-21.promise: God promises that peace be to you. As Father has sent me, even so he sends you.

jhn-20-22-23.promise: He breathed on them: Receive the Holy Spirit! If you forgive anyone’s sins, they have been forgiven. If you retain anyone’s sins, they have been retained.

jhn-20-27-29.promise: Don’t be unbelieving, but believing. Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are people who have not seen and have believed.
jhn-20-27-29.context: Blessed who haven’t seen yet believe.

jhn-20-31.promise: These are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God. That believing you may have life in his name.
jhn-20-31.context: Written for life in his name.

act-1-8.promise: You will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you. You will be witnesses to me in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria. To the uttermost parts of the earth.
act-1-8.context: Jesus’ words before he returned to heaven.

act-2-17-18.promise: God promises that in the last days he will pour out his Spirit on all flesh; sons and daughters will prophesy; young men see visions; old men dream; on servants I pour out his Spirit.
act-2-17-18.context: Peter explains the Spirit’s coming with Joel’s words.

act-2-21.promise: God promises that everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.
act-2-21.context: Anyone who calls on the Lord can be saved.

act-2-38-39.promise: Repent and be baptized in Jesus’ name for forgiveness of sins, and you will receive the Holy Spirit. The promise is to you, your children, and all who are far off. Everyone the Lord calls.
act-2-38-39.context: Forgiveness and the Spirit are offered widely.

act-3-19-21.promise: Turn back to God so your sins may be wiped away. Times of refreshing will come from the Lord’s presence, until God restores all things.
act-3-19-21.context: Turning back to God brings refreshment.

act-4-12.promise: There is salvation in no one else. No other name under heaven given among men by which we must be saved.

act-10-34-35.promise: God doesn’t show favoritism; in every nation the one who fears him. Works righteousness is acceptable to him.

act-10-43.promise: Everyone who believes in Jesus receives forgiveness of sins through his name.

act-13-38-39.promise: Through this man remission of sins is proclaimed; by him everyone who believes is made right with God from all things the law of Moses could not justify.

act-16-31.promise: Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ. You will be saved, you and your household.

act-18-9-10.promise: God promises that don’t be afraid, but speak and don’t be silent; he is with you, and no one will attack you to harm you, for he has many people in this city.

act-26-17-18.promise: God promises that he sends you to open eyes, turn from darkness to light and from Satan’s power to God, that they may receive remission of sins and an inheritance among the sanctified by faith in me.

rom-1-16-17.promise: God says he is not ashamed of the Good News—it is God’s power of salvation to everyone who believes. In it God’s righteousness is revealed from faith to faith; the righteous shall live by faith.

rom-3-21-24.promise: Apart from law, God’s righteousness is revealed through faith in Jesus Christ to all who believe. All have sinned and fall short. Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption in Christ Jesus.

rom-3-25-26.promise: God set forth Jesus as a mercy seat through faith in his blood—that he might be just. The justifier of the one who has faith in Jesus.

rom-4-5.promise: To anyone who doesn’t work but believes in him who justifies the ungodly, faith is accounted for righteousness.

rom-4-7-8.promise: God promises a real blessing: blessed are those whose sins are forgiven, whose sins are covered. Blessed is the one whom the Lord will by no means charge with sin.

rom-4-16-17.promise: The promise is of faith according to grace, sure to all the children—before God who gives life to the dead and calls things that are not as though they were.
rom-4-16-17.context: Sure promise; life to the dead.

rom-4-20-22.promise: Abraham grew strong through faith, fully assured that what God had promised he was also able to perform. Credited as righteousness.

rom-5-1-2.promise: Justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ. Through him we have access into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
rom-5-1-2.context: Peace with God; hope of glory.

rom-5-3-5.promise: We rejoice in sufferings—suffering produces perseverance, character, hope. And hope doesn’t disappoint, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit given to us.

rom-5-6-8.promise: While we were still weak, Christ died for the ungodly. God shows his love for us in this: while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.

rom-5-9-11.promise: Since we have been made right with God by Jesus’ blood, we will be saved from wrath through him. If we were reconciled to God by his Son’s death while we were enemies, how much more will we be saved by his life.

rom-5-17.promise: Those who receive God’s abundant grace and the gift of righteousness will reign in life through Jesus Christ.

rom-5-20-21.promise: Where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly. So grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

rom-6-4-5.promise: Buried with him through baptism into death, we might walk in newness of life. United with him in death, we will also be part of his resurrection.

rom-6-14.promise: Sin will not have care for you, for you are not under law but under grace.

rom-6-23.promise: The wages of sin is death, but God’s free gift is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

rom-8-1-2.promise: There is therefore now no condemnation to people who are in Christ Jesus. The law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.

rom-8-6.promise: The mind set on the flesh leads to death, but the mind set on the Spirit is life and peace.

rom-8-9-11.promise: You are in the Spirit if God’s Spirit lives in you. If Christ is in you, your spirit is alive because of righteousness. And the Spirit who raised Jesus will also give life to your mortal bodies.

rom-8-14-16.promise: As many as are led by the Spirit of God are children of God. You didn’t receive a spirit of bondage again to fear, but the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, Abba! Father!
rom-8-14-16.context: Adoption; Abba; no spirit of fear.

rom-8-17.promise: If children, then heirs. Heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified with him.

rom-8-18.promise: The sufferings of this present time are not worth comparing with the glory that will be revealed to us.

rom-8-26-27.promise: The Spirit helps our weaknesses. We don’t know how to pray as we ought, but the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings that can’t be uttered, according to God.

rom-8-28.promise: God promises that he works all things together for good for those who love him and are called according to his purpose.

rom-8-29-30.promise: Whom he foreknew he also predestined to be conformed to his Son’s image. Whom he predestined he also called. Whom he called he also justified.

rom-8-31-32.promise: If God is for us, who can be against us? He who didn’t spare his own Son but delivered him up for us all. How will he not also with him freely give us all things?
rom-8-31-32.context: God for us; freely give all.

rom-8-33-34.promise: Who could bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? It is God who justifies. Who condemns?

rom-8-35-37.promise: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ. Tribulation, anguish, persecution, famine, nakedness, danger, or sword? In all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

rom-8-38-39.promise: Nothing can separate you from God’s love in Christ Jesus—not death, life, angels, powers, or anything else in all creation.
rom-8-38-39.context: Nothing can separate from God’s love.

rom-10-9-11.promise: If you confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved. Everyone who believes in him will not be put to shame.

rom-10-12-13.promise: There is no distinction between Jew and Greek. The same Lord is Lord of all and rich to all who call on him. Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.

rom-11-29.promise: God’s gifts and his calling are never taken back.

rom-12-1-2.promise: Present your bodies a living sacrifice. Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so you may prove God’s good, well-pleasing, and perfect will.

rom-12-12.promise: Rejoice in hope, be patient in trouble, and keep on praying.

rom-12-19.promise: Do not take revenge; leave room for God’s justice. Vengeance belongs to the Lord, and he will repay.
rom-12-19.context: Paul’s call to lived worship includes releasing personal vengeance into God’s hands.

rom-15-4.promise: Whatever was written in the past was written to teach us, so that through endurance and the encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.

rom-15-13.promise: May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you trust him, so that you may overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.
rom-15-13.context: God of hope fills joy and peace.

1co-1-8-9.promise: God will keep you firm to the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ. God is faithful—he called you into fellowship with his Son.

1co-1-18.promise: The word of the cross is foolishness to people who are dying, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.

1co-1-27-29.promise: God chose the foolish, weak. He also base things of the world to put to shame the wise and strong—that no flesh should boast before God.

1co-2-9-10.promise: Things which eye didn’t see and ear didn’t hear, and which didn’t enter into the heart of man, God has prepared for people who love him. But to us, God revealed them through the Spirit.
1co-2-9-10.context: Prepared for those who love him.

1co-2-12.promise: We have not received the spirit of the world, but the Spirit who is from God, so that we may understand what God has freely given us.

1co-3-16-17.promise: Don’t you know that you are God’s temple and that God’s Spirit lives in you? If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him. For God’s temple is holy, which you are.

1co-6-14.promise: God raised up the Lord. Will also raise us up by his power.

1co-6-19-20.promise: Your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit, who is in you and whom you have from God. You are not your own—you were bought with a price.

1co-10-13.promise: No temptation has seized you except what is common to people. God is faithful. He will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear, and he will provide a way out so you can endure.

1co-12-4-7.promise: There are various kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit. Various servings, same Lord. Various workings, same God who works all in all. But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the common good.

1co-13-4-8.promise: Love is patient and kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love bears, believes, hopes, and endures all things. Love never fails.

1co-13-12-13.promise: God promises that now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then he will know fully, even as I was also fully known. Now faith, hope, and love remain—these three.

1co-15-3-4.promise: Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures, was buried. Was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures.

1co-15-20-22.promise: But now Christ has been raised from the dead, the first fruits of people who are asleep. For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.

1co-15-51-52.promise: We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed. In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. The trumpet will sound, the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.

1co-15-54-57.promise: Death is swallowed up in victory. Where, O death, is your sting? Thanks be to God! He gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

1co-15-58.promise: Therefore, beloved friends, stand firm. Let nothing move you. Always give yourselves fully to the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor in the Lord is not in vain.

1co-16-13-14.promise: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous!

2co-1-3-4.promise: God is the Father of mercies and God of all comfort. He comforts you in every trouble so you can comfort others.

2co-1-5.promise: Just as the sufferings of Christ overflow to us, so also our comfort overflows through Christ.

2co-1-20.promise: However many promises God has made, they are “Yes” in Christ. And through him we say “Amen” to the glory of God.
2co-1-20.context: All God’s promises Yes in Christ.

2co-1-21-22.promise: It is God who makes us stand firm in Christ. He anointed us, set his seal of ownership on us, and put his Spirit in our hearts as a deposit.

2co-3-17-18.promise: Now the Lord is the Spirit. And where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty. We all, with unveiled face seeing the Lord’s glory as in a mirror, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.

2co-4-6.promise: God, who said “Light will shine out of darkness,” has shone in our hearts to give us the light of the knowledge of God’s glory in the face of Jesus Christ.

2co-4-7-9.promise: We carry God’s treasure in fragile jars of clay, so the power is clearly his. We may be pressed and confused, but we are not crushed, forsaken, or destroyed.
2co-4-7-9.context: Clay vessels; not crushed or forsaken.

2co-4-16-18.promise: Therefore we don’t faint. Though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day. For our light suffering, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory.
2co-4-16-18.context: Renewed day by day; eternal weight of glory.

2co-5-1.promise: We know that if the earthly tent we live in is destroyed, we have a building from God—an eternal house in heaven, not built by human hands.

2co-5-5.promise: God himself prepared us for this, and he gave us the Spirit as a deposit guaranteeing what is to come.

2co-5-7.promise: We walk by faith, not by sight.

2co-5-17.promise: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. all things have become new.

2co-5-18-19.promise: All things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation. Namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses.

2co-5-21.promise: God made him who knew no sin to be sin for us, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

2co-6-2.promise: now is the acceptable time. now is the day of salvation.

2co-6-16-18.promise: God says he will dwell in them and walk in them. I will be their God, and they will be my people. I will be to you a Father, and you will be to me sons and daughters, says the Lord Almighty.

2co-7-6.promise: But God, who comforts the downcast, comforted us by the coming of Titus.

2co-9-6-8.promise: God promises that anyone who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly. He who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully. God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.

2co-9-10-11.promise: God promises that anyone who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food will supply and multiply your seed for sowing, and increase the fruits of your righteousness. You will be enriched in everything for all generosity.

2co-12-9-10.promise: God promises that he has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore he will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me. When he is weak, then he is strong.
