2co-13-11.promise: Finally, brothers, rejoice! Be perfected. Be comforted.
2co-13-11.context: God of love and peace with you.

2co-13-14.promise: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God. The fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all.

gal-2-20.promise: God promises that he has been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself up for me.
gal-2-20.context: Christ lives in me; loved me.

gal-3-13-14.promise: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us, so that the blessing given to Abraham might come to the nations through Christ Jesus—and so that by faith we might receive the promise of the Spirit.

gal-3-26-29.promise: You are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus. For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ. There is neither Jew nor Greek, slave nor free, male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

gal-4-4-7.promise: When the time was right, God sent his Son so we could be adopted as his children. You are no longer a slave but a child—and if a child, then an heir through God.

gal-5-1.promise: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free. Don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.

gal-5-13-14.promise: You were called to freedom… through love be servants to one another. For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”.

gal-5-16-18.promise: Walk by the Spirit. You won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh. If you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

gal-5-22-23.promise: The fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith, gentleness. Self-control. Against such things there is no law.

gal-6-2.promise: Bear one another’s burdens. So fulfill the law of Christ.

gal-6-7-9.promise: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap. Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we do not give up.
gal-6-7-9.context: Reap in due season; don’t give up.

eph-1-3-6.promise: God has blessed us in Christ with every spiritual blessing. In love he chose us to be holy and adopted us as his children, to the praise of his glorious grace.

eph-1-7-8.promise: In Jesus we have redemption through his blood—the forgiveness of sins—according to the riches of God’s grace, which he poured out on us.

eph-1-13-14.promise: In him you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation. In whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit, who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of his glory.
eph-1-13-14.context: Sealed with Spirit; pledge of inheritance.

eph-2-4-7.promise: But God, rich in mercy and great in love, made us alive with Christ even when we were dead in sins. By grace you have been saved—and he shows the riches of his kindness forever.
eph-2-4-7.context: Rich in mercy; made alive; seated with Christ.

eph-2-8-10.promise: For by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves. It is the gift of God, not of works, that no one would boast. For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand that we would walk in them.

eph-2-13-14.promise: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of Christ. For he is our peace, who made both one. Broke down the middle wall of separation.
eph-2-13-14.context: Far off made near; he is our peace.

eph-2-18-19.promise: Through Jesus we both have access to the Father by one Spirit. So you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but fellow citizens with God’s people and members of his household.
eph-2-18-19.context: Access to Father; household of God.

eph-2-20-22.promise: Being built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief cornerstone. In whom the whole building, fitted together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord. In whom you also are built together for a habitation of God in the Spirit.
eph-2-20-22.context: Habitation of God in the Spirit.

eph-3-12.promise: In Christ we have boldness and confident access to God through faith in him.

eph-3-16-19.promise: God strengthens you with power through his Spirit in your inner person, so Christ may live in your heart by faith—and you may know his love that surpasses knowledge.
eph-3-16-19.context: Christ dwells; know surpassing love; filled with fullness.

eph-3-20-21.promise: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us, to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations forever. Amen.
eph-3-20-21.context: Able to do above all we ask or think.

eph-4-4-6.promise: There is one body and one Spirit—just as you were called to one hope—one Lord, one faith, one baptism, one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in all.

eph-4-22-24.promise: Put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit. Be renewed in the spirit of your mind, and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.

eph-4-26-27.promise: “Be angry. Don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath, and don’t give place to the devil.
eph-4-26-27.context: Be angry without sin; do not give the devil a foothold.

eph-4-32.promise: Be kind and tenderhearted to one another, forgiving each other, just as God in Christ forgave you.

eph-5-1-2.promise: Be imitators of God, as beloved children. Walk in love, just as Christ loved us and gave himself up for us.

eph-5-8-9.promise: You were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Walk as children of light—for the fruit of the light is goodness, righteousness, and truth.

eph-5-14.promise: Awake, you who sleep. Arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.

eph-6-10-11.promise: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in his mighty power. Put on the whole armor of God, so you can stand against the devil’s schemes.

eph-6-13.promise: Therefore put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day. Having done all, to stand.

eph-6-16-17.promise: Above all, taking up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one. And take the helmet of saving help and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.
eph-6-16-17.context: Shield of faith; helmet of salvation.

php-1-6.promise: God who began a good work in you will carry it through to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.
php-1-6.context: He will complete the good work.

php-1-21.promise: For to me to live is Christ. To die is gain.
php-1-21.context: To live is Christ; to die is gain.

php-2-13.promise: It is God who works in you—giving you both the desire and the power to do what pleases him.
php-2-13.context: God works in you to will and work.

php-3-20-21.promise: Our citizenship is in heaven. We wait for a Savior from there—the Lord Jesus Christ—who will transform our lowly bodies to be like his glorious body.

php-4-4-5.promise: God promises that rejoice in the Lord always! Again he will say, Rejoice! Let your gentleness be known to all men.

php-4-6-7.promise: God invites you not to stay stuck in worry. Bring everything to him in prayer with thanks—and his peace will guard your heart and mind in Christ Jesus.
php-4-6-7.context: Don’t be anxious; peace will guard.

php-4-8-9.promise: Whatever things are true, honorable, just, pure, lovely, of good report… think about these things. The things which you learned… do these things. The God of peace will be with you.

php-4-11-13.promise: God promises that he has learned in whatever state he is, to be content in it. I know how to be humbled, and I also know how to abound. I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

php-4-19.promise: God promises to supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

col-1-11-12.promise: God strengthens you with all power according to his glorious might, so you may have great endurance and patience with joy, giving thanks to the Father who qualifies you to share in the inheritance of his people in the light.

col-1-13-14.promise: Who delivered us out of the power of darkness. Translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love, in whom we have our redemption, the forgiveness of our sins.

col-1-19-20.promise: For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him. Through him to reconcile all things to himself, by him, whether things on the earth or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.

col-1-21-22.promise: Once you were alienated from God and enemies in your minds because of evil deeds. But now he has reconciled you by Christ’s body through death, to present you holy and blameless in his sight.

col-1-27.promise: God was pleased to make known among the nations the glorious riches of this mystery: Christ in you, the hope of glory.
col-1-27.context: Christ in you, the hope of glory.

col-2-6-7.promise: Just as you received Christ Jesus as Lord, continue to live in him—rooted and built up in him, strengthened in the faith as you were taught, and overflowing with thankfulness.
col-2-6-7.context: Rooted and built up in him.

col-2-9-10.promise: For in him all the fullness of the Deity dwells bodily. In him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power.
col-2-9-10.context: In him you are made full.

col-2-13-14.promise: You were dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh. He made you alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses, wiping out the handwriting in instructions that was against us. He has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross.
col-2-13-14.context: Made alive; handwriting nailed to cross.

col-3-1-4.promise: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God. Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth. For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
col-3-1-4.context: Life hidden with Christ; revealed in glory.

col-3-12-15.promise: Put on, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance; bearing with one another, and forgiving each other… even as Christ forgave you, so you also do. Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.
col-3-12-15.context: Chosen, holy, beloved; peace rule; love.

col-3-16-17.promise: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly. In all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord. Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
col-3-16-17.context: Word dwell richly; all in Jesus’ name.

1th-1-4-5.promise: We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen. That our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit and with much assurance.

1th-3-12-13.promise: May the Lord make your love increase and overflow for each other and for everyone. May he strengthen your hearts so you will be blameless and holy before our God and Father when Jesus comes.

1th-4-13-14.promise: We don’t want you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning people who have fallen asleep, so that you don’t grieve like the rest, who have no hope. For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with him people who have fallen asleep in Jesus.
1th-4-13-14.context: Grief with hope; God will bring them.

1th-4-16-18.promise: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel and with God’s trumpet. The dead in Christ will rise first, then we who are alive… will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. So we will be with the Lord forever.
1th-4-16-18.context: Caught up; with the Lord forever.

1th-5-9-10.promise: For God did not appoint us to wrath, but to the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ, who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.
1th-5-9-10.context: Appointed to salvation; live with him.

1th-5-16-18.promise: Always rejoice. Pray without stopping. Give thanks in everything—for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.

1th-5-23-24.promise: May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul. Body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ. He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.

2th-1-6-7.promise: Since it is a righteous thing with God to repay suffering to those who afflict you, and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels.

2th-2-13-14.promise: We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for saving help through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth, to which he called you through our Good News, for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
2th-2-13-14.context: Loved; chosen for salvation and glory.

2th-2-16-17.promise: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself. God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace, comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.

2th-3-3.promise: The Lord is faithful. He will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.

2th-3-16.promise: May the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times and in every way. The Lord be with you all.
2th-3-16.context: Lord of peace; with you all.

1ti-1-14-15.promise: God promises that the grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus. The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom he is chief.

1ti-2-3-6.promise: This is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior, who desires all people to be saved and come to full knowledge of the truth. For there is one God and one mediator between God and men, the person Christ Jesus, who gave himself as a ransom for all.
1ti-2-3-6.context: Desires all saved; one mediator; ransom.

1ti-4-8-10.promise: Godliness is profitable for all things, having promise of the life which is now and of that which is to come. For to this end we both labor and suffer reproach, because we have set our trust in the living God, who is the Savior of all men, especially of people who believe.
1ti-4-8-10.context: Promise of life now and to come.

1ti-6-6-8.promise: But godliness with contentment is great gain. For we brought nothing into the world. We certainly can’t carry anything out. But having food and clothing, we will be content with that.

1ti-6-12.promise: Fight the good fight of faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called. You confessed the good confession in the sight of many witnesses.

1ti-6-17-19.promise: Charge people who are rich… that they not be arrogant, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty of riches, but on the living God, who richly provides us with everything to enjoy… laying up for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold of eternal life.
1ti-6-17-19.context: Hope on living God who richly provides.

2ti-1-7.promise: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love. Self-control.

2ti-1-9-10.promise: God saved us and called us with a holy calling—not because of our works, but because of his own purpose and grace given in Christ Jesus.
2ti-1-9-10.context: Saved and called by grace; abolished death.

2ti-1-12.promise: God promises that for this cause I also suffer these things. Yet he is not ashamed, for I know him whom he has believed, and he is persuaded that he is able to guard that which he has committed to him against that day.
2ti-1-12.context: He is able to guard what I committed.

2ti-2-11-13.promise: Faithful is the saying: For if we died with him, we will also live with him. If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.

2ti-2-19.promise: However, God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal: “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Let every one who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.”.
2ti-2-19.context: The Lord knows those who are his.

2ti-3-15-17.promise: The holy Scriptures can make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus. All Scripture is God-breathed and useful—so you may be complete and equipped for every good work.
2ti-3-15-17.context: Scriptures make wise for salvation; equip.

2ti-4-7-8.promise: God promises that he has fought the good fight. he has finished the course. he has kept the faith.
2ti-4-7-8.context: Crown of righteousness for all who love his appearing.

2ti-4-17-18.promise: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me… The Lord will deliver me from every evil work and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory forever. Amen.
2ti-4-17-18.context: Lord stood by; will preserve for kingdom.

tit-1-1-2.promise: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s chosen ones and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness, in hope of eternal life, which God, who cannot lie, promised before time began.
tit-1-1-2.context: God who can’t lie promised eternal life.

tit-2-11-14.promise: God’s grace has appeared, bringing salvation for all people. It trains us to live upright lives while we wait for our great God and Savior Jesus Christ, who gave himself to redeem us.
tit-2-11-14.context: Grace brings salvation; blessed hope; purify a people.

tit-3-4-7.promise: When God’s kindness and love appeared, he saved us—not by our works of righteousness, but by his mercy—through the washing of new birth and renewal by the Holy Spirit.
tit-3-4-7.context: Saved by mercy; Spirit poured; heirs of eternal life.

phm-1-4-7.promise: Paul thanks God for Philemon’s love and faith. The hearts of the saints have been refreshed through him—a picture of how love builds up God’s people.
phm-1-4-7.context: Love refreshes hearts of the saints.

heb-1-3.promise: His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance. Upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purified us of our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high.

heb-2-14-15.promise: Jesus shared our flesh and blood so that through death he might break the power of the devil and free those who lived in fear of death.

heb-2-17-18.promise: He was obligated in all things to be made like his brothers, that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make atonement for the sins of the people. For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help people who are tempted.
heb-2-17-18.context: Merciful high priest able to help the tempted.

heb-3-6.promise: Christ is faithful as a Son over God’s house. We are his house, if we hold firmly to our confidence and the hope we boast in.
heb-3-6.context: We are his house; hold hope firm.

heb-4-9-11.promise: There remains a Sabbath rest for the people of God. Anyone who enters God’s rest also rests from their own works, just as God did. So make every effort to enter that rest.

heb-4-12-13.promise: For the word of God is living and active. Sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart. There is no creature that is hidden from his sight.

heb-4-14-16.promise: Having then a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, let’s hold tightly to our confession. For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.
heb-4-14-16.context: Throne of grace; help in time of need.

heb-6-10.promise: For God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that you served the saints. Still do serve them.
heb-6-10.context: God will not forget your labor of love.

heb-6-17-19.promise: God wanted the heirs of the promise to be sure, so he confirmed it with an oath. We have this hope as a strong and steady anchor for the soul.

heb-7-24-25.promise: But he, because he lives forever, has his priesthood unchangeable. Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost people who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.
heb-7-24-25.context: Able to save to the uttermost; forever intercedes.

heb-8-10-12.promise: God promises that this is the lasting promise that he will make with the house of Israel after those days, says the Lord: he will put my laws into their mind; he will also write them on their heart. he will be their God, and they will be his people.
heb-8-10-12.context: New lasting promise; laws on heart; sins remembered no more.

heb-9-12.promise: Jesus entered the Most Holy Place once for all by his own blood, not by the blood of goats and calves—and so he obtained eternal redemption.

heb-9-14.promise: How much more will the blood of Christ—who through the eternal Spirit offered himself unblemished to God—cleanse our conscience from dead works to serve the living God.

heb-9-27-28.promise: Inasmuch as it is appointed for men to die once, and after this, judgment, so Christ also, having been offered once to bear the sins of many, will appear a second time, not to deal with sin, but to save people who are eagerly waiting for him.
heb-9-27-28.context: Will appear to save those waiting.

heb-10-14.promise: For by one offering he has perfected forever those who are being made holy.

heb-10-16-17.promise: God promises that this is the lasting promise that he will make with them after those days,” says the Lord, “he will put my laws on their heart, he will also write them on their mind;” then he says, “he will remember their sins and their sins no more.
heb-10-16-17.context: God promises to forget sins he has forgiven.

heb-10-19-22.promise: Because of Jesus’ blood, we have boldness to enter God’s holy presence. So draw near with a true heart, in full assurance of faith.

heb-10-23.promise: Let’s hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering. For he who promised is faithful.

heb-10-35-36.promise: Therefore do not throw away your boldness, which has a great reward. For you need endurance so that, having done the will of God, you may receive the promise.

heb-11-1.promise: Faith is being sure of what we hope for, and certain of what we do not see.

heb-11-6.promise: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of people who seek him.
heb-11-6.context: God rewards those who seek him.

heb-11-11.promise: By faith even Sarah herself received power to conceive. She bore a child when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised.

heb-12-1-2.promise: Surrounded by so many witnesses, let us run with endurance the race set before us, looking to Jesus—the one who begins and finishes our faith.
heb-12-1-2.context: Run looking to Jesus, author and perfecter.

heb-12-5-6.promise: My son, don’t take lightly the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when you are reproved by him. For whom the Lord loves, he disciplines, and chastises every son whom he receives.
heb-12-5-6.context: Whom the Lord loves he disciplines.

heb-12-10-11.promise: He disciplines us for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness. All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous. Yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been trained by it.

heb-12-28.promise: Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that cannot be shaken, let’s have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe.

heb-13-5-6.promise: God promises, “I will never leave you or forsake you.” So you can say with confidence that the Lord is your helper.
heb-13-5-6.context: Never leave nor forsake; helper; no fear.

heb-13-8.promise: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today. Forever.

heb-13-20-21.promise: The God of peace, who raised the great Shepherd Jesus, will equip you with everything good to do his will—working in you what pleases him.
heb-13-20-21.context: God of peace; great shepherd; eternal lasting promise; complete you.

jas-1-2-4.promise: Count it all joy when you face trials of many kinds. You know that the testing of your faith produces endurance—and endurance must finish its work so you may be mature and complete, not lacking anything.

jas-1-5-6.promise: If you lack wisdom, ask God. He gives generously to all without finding fault—and it will be given to you.

jas-1-12.promise: Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to people who love him.
jas-1-12.context: Crown of life promised to those who love him.

jas-1-17-18.promise: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, who does not change like shifting shadows. He chose to give us birth through the word of truth.
jas-1-17-18.context: Every good gift; Father of lights; birth by word.

jas-1-19-20.promise: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger. For the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.
jas-1-19-20.context: Swift to hear, slow to speak and anger.

jas-2-5.promise: Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose people who are poor in this world to be rich in faith and heirs of the Kingdom which he promised to people who love him?
jas-2-5.context: Heirs of the Kingdom promised to lovers of God.

jas-2-12-13.promise: So speak and so do as people who are to be judged by the law of freedom. For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.

jas-4-6-8.promise: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.” Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
jas-4-6-8.context: More grace; draw near and he draws near.

jas-4-10.promise: Humble yourselves before the Lord, and he will lift you up.

jas-5-7-8.promise: Be patient therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and late rain. You also be patient.

jas-5-11.promise: we call them blessed who endured. You have heard of the perseverance of Job and have seen the Lord in the outcome, and how the Lord is full of compassion and mercy.
jas-5-11.context: Lord full of compassion and mercy.

jas-5-13-16.promise: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful?

1pe-1-3-5.promise: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy became our father again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead, to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you, who by the power of God are.

1pe-1-6-7.promise: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been grieved in various trials, that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes even though it is tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory. Honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
1pe-1-6-7.context: Trials prove faith; praise at revelation.

1pe-1-8-9.promise: Whom, not having known, you love. In him, though now you don’t see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy that is unspeakable and full of glory, receiving the result of your faith, the saving help of your souls.

1pe-1-18-19.promise: You were redeemed—not with perishable things like silver or gold, but with the precious blood of Christ, a lamb without blemish or defect.

1pe-1-23-25.promise: You have been born again, not of perishable seed, but of imperishable, through the living and enduring word of God. People are like grass, but the word of the Lord endures forever.

1pe-2-4-6.promise: Coming to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious. You also as living stones are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood… Because it is contained in Scripture, “I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen and precious: He who believes in him will not be disappointed.”.

1pe-2-9-10.promise: You are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, God’s special possession—that you may declare the praises of him who called you out of darkness into his wonderful light. Once you were not a people, but now you are God’s people.

1pe-2-24-25.promise: Jesus himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, so that we might die to sins and live for righteousness. By his wounds you have been healed. You were like sheep going astray, but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
1pe-2-24-25.context: Bore sins; healed by wounds; returned to Shepherd.

1pe-3-8-9.promise: Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous, not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult. But instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing.
1pe-3-8-9.context: Called to bless; inherit a blessing.

1pe-3-12.promise: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against people who do evil.
1pe-3-12.context: Eyes on righteous; ears open to prayer.

1pe-3-18.promise: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, those who walk with God for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the Spirit.
1pe-3-18.context: Righteous for unrighteous; bring you to God.

1pe-4-12-13.promise: Beloved, do not be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you. But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice, that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy.
1pe-4-12-13.context: Share sufferings; rejoice at glory’s revelation.

1pe-4-19.promise: So then, those who suffer according to God’s will should commit themselves to their faithful Creator and continue to do good.

1pe-5-6-7.promise: God cares for you. Humble yourself under his hand, and cast all your worries on him—he holds you.
1pe-5-6-7.context: Cast worries; he cares for you.

1pe-5-8-10.promise: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.
1pe-5-8-10.context: God of all grace will perfect and strengthen after suffering.

2pe-1-3-4.promise: Seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue, by which he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises; that through these you may become partakers of the divine nature, having.
2pe-1-3-4.context: Precious promises; partakers of divine nature.

2pe-1-10-11.promise: Therefore, brothers, be more diligent to make your calling and election sure. For if you do these things, you will never stumble. For thus you will be richly supplied with the entrance into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.

2pe-3-8-9.promise: But don’t forget this one thing, beloved, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day. The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness. But he is patient with us, not wishing that anyone should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
2pe-3-8-9.context: Not slow; patient; not wishing any perish.

2pe-3-13.promise: But according to his promise, we are looking forward to a new heaven and a new earth, where righteousness lives.
2pe-3-13.context: New heavens and new earth promised.

1jn-1-5-7.promise: God promises to be your safe place. When you call on him, he is like a strong rock and shield who protects and rescues you.
1jn-1-5-7.context: Walk in light; blood cleanses from all sin.

1jn-1-8-9.promise: If we confess our sins, God is faithful and just to forgive us and to cleanse us from all wrong.
1jn-1-8-9.context: Confess; faithful to forgive and cleanse.

1jn-2-1-2.promise: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous. And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins. Not for ours only, but also for the whole world.
1jn-2-1-2.context: Counselor with the Father; atoning sacrifice.

1jn-2-12.promise: God promises that i write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.
1jn-2-12.context: Sins forgiven for his name’s sake.

1jn-2-17.promise: The world and its desires are passing away, but whoever does the will of God lives forever.
1jn-2-17.context: Doer’s of God’s will remain forever.

1jn-2-25.promise: This is what he promised us—eternal life.

1jn-3-1-2.promise: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him. Beloved, now we are children of God.
1jn-3-1-2.context: Called children; we will be like him.

1jn-3-8.promise: God promises that anyone who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed: that he might destroy the works of the devil.
1jn-3-8.context: Son revealed to destroy devil’s works.

1jn-3-16.promise: This is how we know what love is: Jesus laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for our brothers and sisters.
1jn-3-16.context: He laid down his life for us.

1jn-3-19-20.promise: And by this we know that we are of the truth and persuade our hearts before him, because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart. Knows all things.

1jn-3-21-22.promise: Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God. So whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.

1jn-4-4.promise: You are of God, little children, and have overcome—because the One in you is greater than the one in the world.

1jn-4-7-10.promise: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God. He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love. By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only born Son into the world that we might live through him.
1jn-4-7-10.context: God is love; he loved us first.

1jn-4-16-18.promise: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him. In this, love has been made perfect among us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because as he is, even so we are in this world.

1jn-4-19.promise: We love because he first loved us.

1jn-5-4-5.promise: Everyone born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: our faith. Who overcomes the world? The one who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.

1jn-5-11-13.promise: God promises that the testimony is this: that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son. He who has the Son has the life. He who doesn’t have God’s Son doesn’t have the life.
1jn-5-11-13.context: Know that you have eternal life.

1jn-5-14-15.promise: This is the confidence we have in him: if we ask anything according to his will, he hears us. And if we know he hears us, we know we have what we asked of him.
1jn-5-14-15.context: He listens; we have what we asked.

1jn-5-18.promise: We know that whoever is born of God doesn’t sin, but he who was born of God keeps himself. The evil one doesn’t touch him.

2jn-1-2-3.promise: For the truth’s sake, which remains in us. It will be with us forever: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
2jn-1-2-3.context: Grace, mercy, and peace; truth forever.

3jn-1-2.promise: Beloved friend, I pray that you may prosper in all things and be in good health, just as your soul is getting along well.
3jn-1-2.context: Prosper and be healthy as soul prospers.

jud-1-1.promise: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to those who are called, made holy by God the Father, and kept for Jesus Christ.

jud-1-20-21.promise: But you, beloved, build yourselves up in your most holy faith and pray in the Holy Spirit. Keep yourselves in God’s love as you wait for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to bring you eternal life.
jud-1-20-21.context: Keep in God’s love; mercy to eternal life.

jud-1-24-25.promise: God is able to keep you from stumbling and to present you faultless before his glory with great joy. To him be glory forever.
jud-1-24-25.context: Able to keep from stumbling; present faultless with joy.

rev-1-3.promise: Blessed is he who reads and people who hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written in it, for the time is near.

rev-1-5-6.promise: Jesus Christ, those who trust him witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who loves us, and washed us from our sins by his blood—and he made us to be a Kingdom, priests to his God and Father—to him be the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.
rev-1-5-6.context: Loves us; washed from sins; made us kingdom priests.

rev-1-17-18.promise: Don’t be afraid. I am the first and the last. The Living one. I was dead, and behold, I am alive forever and ever. I have the keys of Death and of Hades.
rev-1-17-18.context: Don’t fear; alive forever; keys of Death.

rev-2-7.promise: God promises that he who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes he will give to eat from the tree of life, which is in the Paradise of my God.
rev-2-7.context: Overcome; eat from tree of life.

rev-2-10.promise: God promises that don’t be afraid of the things which you are about to suffer. the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested; and you will have oppression for ten days. Be faithful to death, and he will give you the crown of life.
rev-2-10.context: Faithful to death; crown of life.

rev-2-11.promise: God promises that anyone who overcomes won’t be harmed by the second death.
rev-2-11.context: Overcome; not harmed by second death.

rev-2-17.promise: God promises that to him who overcomes, he will give of the hidden manna, and he will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written which no one knows but he who receives it.

rev-2-26-28.promise: God promises that he who overcomes, and he who keeps my works to the end, to him he will give authority over the nations… and he will give him the morning star.

rev-3-5.promise: God promises that he who overcomes will be arrayed in white garments, and he will in no way blot his name out of the book of life, and he will confess his name before my Father and before his angels.
rev-3-5.context: White garments; name in book of life.

rev-3-8.promise: God promises that i know your works. he has set before you an open door, which no one can shut, which you have, that you have a little power, and kept my word, and didn’t deny his name.
rev-3-8.context: Open door no one can shut.

rev-3-10.promise: Because you kept Jesus’ call to endure, he promises to keep you through the hour of testing that is coming on the world.
rev-3-10.context: Kept; will keep from hour of testing.

rev-3-11-12.promise: God says he is coming quickly! Hold firmly that which you have, so that no one takes your crown. He who overcomes, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God, and he will go out from there no more.
rev-3-11-12.context: A lasting place with God, marked by his name.

rev-3-19-21.promise: God promises that as many as I love, I rebuke and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent. I stand at the door and knock.
rev-3-19-21.context: Love rebukes; knock; dine; sit on throne.

rev-5-9-10.promise: You are worthy to take the book and to open its seals, for you were killed, and bought us for God with your blood out of every tribe, language, people, and nation, and made us kings and priests to our God. And we will reign on the earth.
rev-5-9-10.context: Bought with blood; kings and priests; will reign.

rev-7-9-10.promise: John sees a great crowd from every nation standing before the throne and the Lamb, clothed in white, crying out that salvation belongs to God and to the Lamb.
rev-7-9-10.context: Countless multitude; salvation to God and Lamb.

rev-7-15-17.promise: Therefore they are before the throne of God, and they serve him day and night in his temple. He who sits on the throne will spread his tabernacle over them. They will never be hungry or thirsty any more.

rev-11-15.promise: The seventh angel sounded, and great voices in heaven followed, saying, “The kingdom of the world has become the Kingdom of our Lord and of his Christ. He will reign forever and ever!”.
rev-11-15.context: Kingdom of world becomes Lord’s; reign forever.

rev-12-10-11.promise: Heaven announces salvation and God’s kingdom. Believers overcame the accuser by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony—they did not love their lives even to death.
rev-12-10-11.context: Accuser thrown down; overcome by Lamb’s blood.

rev-14-12-13.promise: Here is the perseverance of the saints, those who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus. I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Write, ‘Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.’” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “that they may rest from their labors, for their works follow with them.”.
rev-14-12-13.context: Blessed dead in the Lord; rest from labors.

rev-19-6-7.promise: God promises that i heard something like the voice of a great multitude… saying, “Hallelujah! For the Lord God, the Almighty, reigns! Let’s rejoice and be exceedingly glad, and let’s give the glory to him.
rev-19-6-7.context: Lord reigns; wedding of the Lamb.

rev-19-9.promise: He said to me, “Write, ‘Blessed are those who are invited to the wedding supper of the Lamb.’” He said to me, “These are true words of God.”.

rev-20-6.promise: Blessed and holy is he who has part in the first resurrection. Over these, the second death has no power, but they will be priests of God and of Christ. Will reign with him one thousand years.
rev-20-6.context: First resurrection; second death no power; reign.

rev-21-1-2.promise: God promises that i saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth have passed away, and the sea is no more. I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared like a bride adorned for her husband.
rev-21-1-2.context: New heaven and earth; New Jerusalem.

rev-21-3-4.promise: God promises to live with his people. He will wipe away every tear. Death, pain, and crying will be gone forever.
rev-21-3-4.context: God dwells with people; wipe every tear; death no more.

rev-21-5-7.promise: God promises that he who sits on the throne said, “he is making all things new.” He said, “Write, for these words of God are faithful and true.” He said to me, “It is done! he is the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. he will give freely to him who is thirsty from the spring of the water of life.
rev-21-5-7.context: All things new; free water of life; my son.

rev-21-23-25.promise: The city has no need for the sun or moon to shine, for the very glory of God illuminated it and its lamp is the Lamb. The nations will walk in its light. The kings of the earth bring the glory and honor of the nations into it.
rev-21-23-25.context: Glory illuminates; nations walk in light; no night.

rev-21-26-27.promise: They will bring the glory and the honor of the nations into it. There will in no way enter into it anything profane, or one who causes an abomination or a lie, but only people who are written in the Lamb’s book of life.
rev-21-26-27.context: Only those in Lamb’s book of life.

rev-22-1-2.promise: He showed me a river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb, in the middle of its street. On this side of the river and on that was the tree of life, bearing twelve kinds of fruits, yielding its fruit every month.
rev-22-1-2.context: River of life; tree for healing of nations.

rev-22-3-5.promise: There will be no curse any more. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants will serve him. They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.
rev-22-3-5.context: See his face; no night; reign forever.

rev-22-12.promise: God promises that he is coming quickly! My reward is with me, to repay to each man according to his work.
rev-22-12.context: Jesus is coming, and he brings reward.

rev-22-14.promise: God promises a real blessing: blessed are those who do his commandments, that they may have the right to the tree of life, and may enter in by the gates into the city.
rev-22-14.context: A welcome into God’s city and life.

rev-22-16.promise: God promises that i, Jesus, have sent his angel to testify these things to you for the assemblies. he is the root and the children of David, the Bright and Morning Star.

rev-22-17.promise: The Spirit and the church say, “Come!” If you are thirsty, come. God offers the water of life freely to anyone who wants it.
rev-22-17.context: An open invitation to come to God.

rev-22-20.promise: God promises that he who testifies these things says, “Yes, he is coming quickly.” Amen! Yes, come, Lord Jesus!
rev-22-20.context: Jesus promises he is coming soon.
